notes.content:

ORION as a game series turns 22 today! Originally announced on August 25, 2000 as a mod for the original Half-Life!

notes.title: Guardians of Orion (Phase 2) | OFFICIAL RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Orbital Command, Guardians![/b]
GOO2 has now left the beta phase and entered it's release where everything is feeling great, stable and fully playable across both hosts and clients.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/e69da24476ade7b22313ce7155f9503c48806c2e.png[/img]

[h2][b]GOO2 [/b]| OFFICIAL RELEASE TRAILER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xfhFtlJoYAE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PHASE 2 [/h2]
We just put out a massive release in the form of Guardians of Orion (Phase 2).  
[b]This is a FREE update for all owners of Phase 1.[/b]
[i]+ a better product for any new players still to come:[/i]
• New Game Engine
• New Multiplayer Architecture
• Revamped Single-Player Experience
• Better Graphics
• Better VFX & SFX
• Boots Faster
• Loads Faster
• Reduced File/Install size
• Improved Gameplay Sandbox

[h2]GAME FEATURES [/h2]
[h3](PHASE 2 RELEASE)[/h3]
· 4 Game Modules (OnlineHarvest, OnlineSurvival, Offline, LocalMultiplayer)
• 2 Game Modes (Harvest & Survival)
· 9 Guardians
· 20+ Maps
· 15 Enemy Types
· 40+ Weapons & Gear
· Fatalities
· Destruction
· Gibs & Gore
· Steam Achievements
· Gamepad Support
· NPC & Quests
· Crafting
· Inventory
· Daily Challenges
· Weekly Events
· Accolades & Rewards
· Skill Trees
· Item Store
· Resource Store
· Customization
· Social Lobby
· 5 Difficulty Modes
· Loot & Gear

[h3]PLAY YOUR WAY[/h3]
Featuring First-Person, Third-Person and Top-Down views.  Cycle between all three at the press of a button!

[h3]HERO-BASED GAMEPLAY[/h3]
Featuring nine unique heroes, each with their own gameplay sandbox, skill tree, specialized gear and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/25a2a6b9e797c1f48490e2be8a9c50ebf8b598e0.png[/img]

[h3]WEAPONS & GEAR[/h3]
The sandbox for Guardians of Orion is better than ever.  Featuring a wide variety of classes, weapons, gear, equipment, abilities & more!

[h3]v2.0.75 GAME UPDATE[/h3]
We've just released the v2.0.75 update which signals the Official Release.  More details on v2.0.75 and other updates are available here:

notes.title: GOO2 | Beta Player Feedback Report & Summary
notes.content:
We put together a player feedback questionnaire one week after the release of the GOO2 Beta back in August 2021.  This data helped shape the goals for the GOO2 beta in parallel to our own internal ones as we approach the Official Release.  We appreciate all the great information and feedback you helped by passing our way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/79ce0146fecc13ded09c33ac4b32811e152351ec.png[/img]

[i]NOTE: This data is from September 2021.
NOTE: Many improvements have been made since this data was gathered.[/i]

notes.title: GOO2 | Patch 2.0.73 (Offline Mode 2.0)
notes.content:
We have just published a major update for the GOO2 Beta to fix some of the last core focus areas and remaining issues. 

[b][ v2.0.73 ][/b]
• ADDED: Offline 2.0 Mode.
• ADDED: Offline Progression & Save Data.
• ADDED: Default Armor Visuals for each offline Hero.
• ADDED: Server Browser 2.0 (New Data Tables).
• ADDED: Backwards compatibility for previously unlocked Accolades.
• FIXED: Weekly Modifier carrying over to subsequent games.
• FIXED: Accolades not being granted.
• FIXED: Manual revive not working properly.
• ADJUSTED: Accolades reward logic.
• ADJUSTED: Accolades UI descriptor color.
• ADJUSTED: Optimized Inventory operations.
• ADJUSTED: Game Multiplayer menu now used for Lobby.
• ADJUSTED: HUD for offline local co-op.
• INSPECTED: Credit Pack purchases @ Ion Shop.

______________

[h2]OFFLINE MODE 2.0[/h2]
[h3]PROGRESSION & SAVE DATA[/h3]
We are introducing the revamped OFFLINE MODE in the upcoming v2.0.73 update.  
[i]This update will make the Offline experience better than ever before.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/3ceda4b0bee268278583f8ead8c3527dfbcffec6.png[/img]

[b]1.) PROGRESSION[/b]
Hero Levels and Stats carry over from match to match.

[b]2.) VISUALS[/b]
Armor visuals are now specific to each Hero instead of Universal.

[b]3.) DATA[/b]
Inventory Gear and Skills are persistent from game to game.

[b]4.) MULTIPLE PLAYERS[/b]
Local Offline Multiplayer has an updated User Interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/ffe66e05819ac7cd6360c522c3a0d073a8aeb3e5.png[/img]


[h2]OFFLINE PROFILES[/h2]
You can make a variety of offline user accounts each with their own nine hero slots.  Each of these slots will have progression so the more you play the higher their levels, skills and inventory equipment will become.  Skills and equipped gear will save and carry over from game to game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/16ba24b9aac53f3e08791bb441bb174c177300af.png[/img]


[h2]ALL 9 HEROES[/h2]
[h3]AVAILABLE IN OFFLINE MODE[/h3]
Offline is a great way to experience the gameplay of each of the nine Heroes and see which one is YOUR favorite!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/25a2a6b9e797c1f48490e2be8a9c50ebf8b598e0.png[/img]


[b]<Closing Notes>[/b]
[i]We still have a couple of more patches planned for the beta period ahead of the official release of Guardians of Orion 2.  If you have any issues please reach out directly via Discord, Twitter, Support Email.[/i]

notes.title: GOO2 | New Multiplayer Model
notes.content:
We wanted to give a behind-the-scenes look regarding some elements around the development that made Guardians of Orion (Phase 2) a reality:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/f38b7de7521b37f57482584063393f53052bc022.png[/img]

[h2]PRE-PRODUCTION[/h2]
[h3](2017)[/h3]
The first and foremost aspect we had to complete was the concept of what we wanted to do with GOO2.  This changed a few times, originally starting as just a small quality-of-life patch to fix a dozen or so aspects.  This later finalized and we eventually settled on a sizable and formidable product revamp, focused on core quality changes:
[i]• New Multiplayer Architecture
• Better Graphics
• Better VFX & SFX
• Boots Faster
• Loads Faster
• Reduced File/Install size
• Improved Gameplay Sandbox[/i]


[h2]REPAIRS[/h2]
[h3](2018-2020)[/h3]
Part of the initial hurdle was all of the core changes -- but the biggest obstacle was restoring the multiplayer functionality across things like development changes, legacy servers, engine changes, plugin changes and various others.  This process was all the years leading up to now.


[h2]REACHING THE REMEDY[/h2]
[h3](SPRING 2021)[/h3]
This monumental hurdle was fixed shortly before you all were invited to start playing the alphas/betas in Spring 2021 (April/May).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/4dda18b3cae252b591aeb13f7ad03012bb242686.png[/img]

[h2]THE NEW SETBACK[/h2]
[h3](SPRING 2021)[/h3]
During the last playtest (#003) in early May 2021 we received an update about a bug that I believe we mentioned during one of the earlier tests where we almost had to cancel or postpone test #1 or #2 relating to a 3rd party server issue.

[b]Long story short:[/b]
[i]The server architecture was creating duplicates beyond our control and as a result this was doubling the costs. We reached out to the partner that handles this service and had them begin looking into it.  They ended up finding a fix but it only lasted temporarily.[/i]

[b]LEGACY ARCHITECTURE[/b]
Most importantly and during that time they had mentioned that because it was a bug using a legacy (deprecated) server type that they may not submit a fix for this which means that the cost bug was to be expected to survive indefinitely.

[b]CONVERSION OPTIONS[/b]
Our only option at this point was to spend the time/resources to convert to either their new (non-legacy) 2.0 dedicated server model or to spend the time and resources doing an entirely different model -- player hosted:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/ac064c293e136bae734dd28814c9db3e44897e15.png[/img]

[h1]PLAYER HOSTED SERVERS[/h1]
[h2]("REWRITE")[/h2]
[h3](SUMMER 2021-)[/h3]
In the end we decided to move forward with [player hosted] because of a few reasons:

[b]#1 - PLAYER-FIRST FOCUS[/b]
There was no guarantee that a similar problem wouldn't happen with 2.0 as legacy over time and this ultimately leaves it in our (developer) and your (player) control.

[b]#2 - LONGEVITY[/b]
You can play as long as you want over time, just like Prelude.

[b]#3 - STABILITY[/b]
You can host your own games, won't matter where you are in relation to the old goo1 servers.

[b]#4 - DEVELOPMENT[/b]
The actual workflow and development process is improved because we no longer have to compile multiple builds, upload a server build, deploy a server build and then connect with separate game builds to test out changes and features ([i]which if anything was wrong, make said change and repeat that process[/i]) which could easily add hours per any server-related task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10965848/cc5f51ff3a1589a37fd8265a1b3523ca62efb4d0.png[/img]

[h1]TOO LONG; DIDN'T READ[/h1]
[h2](TL;DR)[/h2]
Initially we had to do a full REPAIR which reached completion in early 2021 when the first Alpha Test was released and players got to experience the game for the first time.  Right after this an external 3rd party issue had forced basically a full REWRITE.

It has been quite the undertaking as this has affected EVERY aspect of the game (player accounts, login, quests, inventory, stats, gear, scaling, characters, loadouts, skills, purchases) and basically everything/anything.  We are finally at a point where everything is systematically in tact and as of the latest release (2.0.72) everything is appearing stable and fully playable.

[h2]THANK YOU![/h2]
We appreciate your feedback and help during this BETA process.  The best way to continue supporting Guardians of Orion (Phase 2) is:

https://twitter.com/dankiedev

3. Consider Upgrading:

notes.title: GOO PHASE 2 | Q3 2018 Development Update
notes.content:
We are updating the release window targets for Guardians of Orion Phase 2.  
[img]https://i.imgur.com/14IQyc7.png[/img]

[h1]GOO PHASE 2 - OUR BIGGEST & BEST SO FAR![/h1]
This is our largest production to date and has been underway for about a year now.  We knew going into this it wouldn't be easy just with the modules and content we wanted to deliver, but also the unexpected variables that can and do popup when lifting the hood.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T0OSptL.png[/img]

In my opinion GOO PHASE 2 is our greatest product to date and we cannot wait to share it with all of you - [i]but only when the time is right[/i].

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5z61zVF9fW2r0eX2sS/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]GOOD STUFF![/h1]
The good news is we've done most of the critical components already, including major aspects such as but not limited to:
[quote]
1. New game engine & technology integrations
2. New FPS Module
3. Optimizations & Polish (Technical)
4. Optimizations & Polish (Rendering)
5. Completely Remastered or Rebuilt Regions 
6. Harvest v2.0

notes.title: GOO Phase 2 | Massive Optimizations (Part 2)
notes.content:
We've been hard at work on Guardians of Orion Phase 2 for months now.  We are very close to wrapping up what is the commencement update (v2.1) and cannot wait to share more information when possible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ROHR6UV.jpg[/img]

[h1]QUALTIY OF LIFE + POLISH[/h1]
Our biggest focus with this update is Quality of Life and POLISH.  We want to clean up the existing experience as much as possible and many of our efforts and resources have been invested in this area.


[h1]NEW PLAYER HUD[/h1]
One of the newer features we've already announced is a brand new PlayerHUD.  This HUD is a much better overall design and conveys the information you need and when you need it. 

It's great for experienced players and new players alike.  We hope to capture some video comparisons showing them side-by-side to illustrate all of the changes we've made very soon!


[h1]MEMORY LEAK & CPU OVERHEAD ISSUE RESOLVED![/h1]
While working on this we found a severe issue from Phase 1 development of GOO.  

There was a memory leak and CPU overhead (at the same time) because of one part of code that used WAY too many resources.  This was UI code (an awful place to have such an issue) and it was all happening just to pull one single texture PER TICK.

[b]This issue has been resolved[/b].  
Issues like these discoveries often take more time to resolve than integrating the initial and intended works but we like to keep this process as open as possible to convey what we're doing and why.

We are making incredible progress on GOO Phase 2 and cannot wait to share it with you.  Thanks for your patience and hope to see you in Space!

notes.title: GOO Phase 2 | Massive Optimizations
notes.content:
The majority of the first Phase 2 update for Guardians of Orion revolves around OPTIMIZATION (and remastering!)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JI8Yz7E.png[/img]


[h1]OPTIMIZATION[/h1]
We have gone through the game and have completely remastered segments where need be including: content and code!  This mixed on a larger scale has seen performance gains across the board.  

We have also started going through as many shaders as possible from Phase 1 and remastering them for either improved visual rendering or shader simplicity - OR sometimes both if lucky enough.  

The Harvester was one of the two-for-ones:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fhSQjr8.png[/img]

We were able to cut a ton of spaghetti as it was overly complex and in the end a basic shader setup was more powerful visually and will of course process/compute better in real-time.  This mixed across many shaders will add to overall performance gains.

Now the performance gains won't be quite as large as they could be, but that is intentional.  

This is due to us going back and remastering the majority of the game to fast-forward it through nearly two years of time and ensure that it looks the best it possibly can moving forward through Phase 2.  

I wanted to attach a comparison of the MOAR REGION from both phases to illustrate this level of quality jump:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2q82UUR.png[/img]

We are getting very close and we cannot wait to share what we've been working so hard on.  Will keep you posted as beta + official release approaches.  

To read more about additional changes for the upcoming update, please check this announcement forecasting the changelog:
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/1688171385763904528

To read more details about why a Phase 2 of development is happening for Guardians of Orion, check the original announcement:
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/1652136246491216093

https://youtu.be/3HrNQLJnebg

To see more comparisons between both Phases, please check this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/1716320065658190431

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Guardians of Orion | Phase 2 | Commencement Video
notes.content:
[h1] SUMMARY [/h1]
"The last major update to Guardians of Orion was in December 2016. I wanted to go into that a bit and then more importantly talk about the future of the game, including a brand new update dropping this year."

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GoWJVVT.png[/img]

[h1]GOO PHASE 2, DEVELOPMENT VIDEO #001[/h1]
This behind-the-scenes development video recaps Guardians of Orion Phase 1 and dives deeper into what is in store for the upcoming and announced Phase 2.
https://youtu.be/3HrNQLJnebg

[quote]
00:12 | Video Summary 
00:25 | Phase 1 Recap
01:15 | DANKIE
01:49 | Learning Lessons
02:40 | Honor/Reward
03:05 | The Reality
03:42 | We Are Proud
04:00 | Phase 1 Closure
04:22 | Perfect Timing
05:03 | Our 3 Goals (v2.1, v2.2)
05:34 | Long Term Goals
05:48 | Version 2.1 Early Preview
08:32 | The Team
09:02 | Our New Core
11:12 | Ending Segment
[/quote]



[h1]DANKIE[/h1]
During this time me and Frankie formed a new focus group called DANKIE which we are working on migrating everything towards. For future products this will allow development to be more internal/localized and focus on new technologies and frameworks. In addition to this we’ve also had a lot of former talent from both SPIRAL and TREK come aboard to assist us on current and upcoming productions, acting as a reunion of sorts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ytQRX3N.png[/img]

To celebrate development starting back up for Guardians of Orion we wanted to discuss a bit more about our first attempt (Phase 1), what we learned and where we hope everything is headed from here on.


[h1]PHASE 1, RECAP[/h1]
Phase 1 of Guardians of Orion lasted from December 2015 (Early Access, v1.0) to December 2016 (Official Release, v2.0).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eJ0eSGz.png[/img]

There were some problems with Guardians of Orion development Phase 1 due to my Hiring, Design, Political and Communication aspects. Other issues had compounded from these problems.

The communication problem stems from using models or platforms such as: Indie, Crowdfunding and Early Access where you need to talk about a games direction, future/possible content and more. There were a variety of these types of discussions all over Social Media, Kickstarters and on Steam Updates.

While this is usually (mostly) fine as either the project is successfully funded and fans hold them accountable based on funds received/stretch goals hit OR the project fails to fund and typically vanishes out to never be heard from again.


[h1]HONOR[/h1]
We made the "interesting" choice of continuing to fund the game regardless, going so far as to even reward the pledges we had never received on Kickstarter to thank those that came out. 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion/posts/1395367

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QReMVYY.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tUps8kw.png[/img]

We believed in this game and so we continued the development and released in December 2015 followed by a full year of massive and free updates to all owners. You can see what was added during that entire year of progress (2015-2016) as well as things we still have hopes of adding:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/orion-sci-fi-open-galaxy-mmorpg-shooter 

[h1]** READ THE REST **[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/1652136246491216093

notes.title: (UPDATED) Guardians of Orion v2.1 (WIP Preview)
notes.content:
[h1]GUARDIANS OF ORION (PHASE 2) *ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT*[/h1]
Guardians of Orion (GOO) is back in active development.  Full details:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/1652136246491216093

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qiqy8KG.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KruisaU.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SQenei2.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uRqHDBJ.png[/img]


[h1]VERSION 2.1[/h1]
GOO Version 2.1 will focus primarily on Quality of Life and Polish Updates, nothing really in the wake of new content.  

This doesn't mean there won't be new experiences though as I am going back and doing a bunch of tweaks and adjustments to most if not all existing maps in the game as of 2.0.53.   

https://youtu.be/nsVO3HhI-2w

This includes not only visual tweaks and enhancements but also gameplay updates and a bunch of optimizations that will hopefully help you run it better than you currently already do. 


[h1]PHASE1 / PHASE 2 COMPARISON[/h1]
In the video above we discuss how with Version 2.1 we are tweaking, polishing and optimizing content already there.  This next video showcases a side-by-side comparison of the 'Raupi WarZone' and 'Eden Jungle' region on Version 2.1 (in development) and Version 2.0 (publicly available):

https://youtu.be/Hso9pvmiOPA
https://youtu.be/8qVzym3GWNA
https://youtu.be/O_CTRZmFc-o
https://youtu.be/3eTtbgkIL5k

[quote]
There are a few things going on here comparison wise that will be covered way more in depth in some upcoming dev diaries but I wanted to talk about some goals with the new changes:

[b][ 1. Readability ][/b]
Eden was one of if not the worst offenders in this category.  The bushes and trees were largely all the same size creating "sameness" everywhere.  More so it was very difficult to locate certain enemy types, more so than desired.

[b][ 2. Less General, More Specific ][/b]
This somewhat ties into readability but basically taking each hot spot on the map and giving it an overall different feel/view.

[b][ 3. The Foliage ][/b]
There is actually more foliage than before, just used completely differently.  In v2.0 it's all the same size and roughly the same distances.  In v2.1 we've added multiple layers of contrast with sizing and color creating a much more pleasant/easy-to-read render.

[b][ 4. The Colors ][/b]
This is probably the biggest change and involves a wide variety of tweaks including the Lighting, Post Processing, Sun Position and more.  The weapon is way more legible and the scene is much more friendly and inviting with colors that pop instead of a grey/brown coverage.  The sun position out of the face allows for less light bleeding which was dominating the scene/colors before in 2.0.
[/quote]

notes.title: Guardians of Orion (Phase 2) Q & A
notes.content:
We've had some great questions come in with the recent announcement of continued Guardians of Orion development and we wanted to address them here.  If you have any others feel free to ask in the comments below!  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pEVa407.png[/img]

[h1](Q) HAVE YOU CONSIDERED STEAM INVENTORY API/TRADING/STEAM MARKETPLACE?[/h1]
(A) This is something we've begun looking into the past week or so.  No details or announcements yet.

[h1](Q) CAN YOU ADD COSMETIC APPEARANCE (ARMOR) ITEMS?[/h1]
(A) Cosmetic/Particle armor parts is a neat idea and something we could definitely look into adding alongside already-existing systems.

[h1](Q) CAN YOU ADD A FRIENDLY FIRE OPTION?[/h1]
(A) This is something we could add but would take a bit more work than meets the eye due to our personal requirements with it.  If and when we add a Friendly Fire (FF) option to the game it'd also come coupled in with a server-side setting (on/off), a vote/kick system (player democracy for any abuse) and of course the FF system itself.

[h1](Q) CAN YOU ADD A "RANDOMIZE APPEARANCE" FEATURE USING ALL THE COSMETICS YOU OWN?[/h1]
(A) This is a really neat idea.  We'll definitely look into something like this.

[h1](Q) LEVEL 600 REDIK IS GETTING PRETTY EASY TO SOLO DUE TO SOME ASPECTS, CAN YOU ADD A NEW MODE BEYOND THAT?[/h1]
(A) Overall gameplay is going to be affected by a bunch of tweaks/adjustments and remasters coming soon alongside many other scheduled/planned ones.  With these each mode will be rebalanced in various ways including a more challenging REDIK.

[h1](Q) CAN YOU ADD ANYTHING ELSE FOR HIGH/MAX LEVEL PLAYERS?[/h1]
(A) Once v2.1 (Quality of Life) and v2.2 (New Content) are released we will be able to better evaluate the product performance and gauge what we get to do and when.  We have big plans for future versions beyond this including reworked Crafting, Inventory, Gear & more.  There are talks of bringing in Crimson and item level 700 as well as a "Prestige" mode which will allow you to take Guardians much further than you presently can.

[h1](Q) MAP CREATOR?[/h1]
(A) This is something planned.

[h1](Q) WITH THE GUARDIAN GAMEPLAY REMASTER, WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO THEIR ORIGINAL WEAPONS? (Burst Rifle, Auto Shotgun, Carbine)[/h1]
(A) There are a few designs we are currently considering but the most popular so far is tentatively labeled 'Universal Weapons' where we simply give them out to all players/all guardians.  

IE more Guardians will have more gameplay customization right out of the gate, including a Level 1 Assault who can use the Auto Rifle (or freely select from the Auto Shotgun, Carbine and Burst Rifle).  

Then the Flame Thrower, Rocket Launcher and Grenade Launcher actually become unlockable weapons towards other owned Guardians once you hit Level 50 with each.



For more details on Guardians of Orion Phase2 please read the official announcement:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/1652136246491216093

notes.title: A Chat with David Prassel; Developer of Guardians of Orion and Orion Prelude
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JMdOq2M.jpg[/img]

[i]Now that David Prassel is back and is officially working on two sequels, we decided to talk to him.
This interview will cover their new projects and some advice about game design."[/i]
If you want to talk to Prassel or any of the fans of GOO you can check out the Discord here:
https://discord.gg/RykWMpC
Source:
http://gamelust.com/news/chat-david-prassel-developer-guardians-orion-orion-prelude/

[h1]1. Since Guardians of Orion, what have you been up to game development wise?[/h1]
Ultimately we grew tired of other peoples actions effecting our names, products or communities so me and Frankie, my main creative partner, split and took most of 2017 off to figure out what we wanted to do next and how we wanted to do it. 

We’ve evolved our skill sets to handle more things locally or directly and we’ve assembled around 10-15 really neat prototypes of various games, genres, IP’s throughout 2017 to figure out what project we wanted to do next. Ultimately it came down to us wanting to deliver the experiences we’ve always wanted and that is where sequels to both ORION: Prelude and Guardians of Orion derived.

https://youtu.be/7Xp-DPu13Pg

Guardians of Orion 2 will be our first video game product as DANKIE (Davey+Frankie). We are going to deliver what we initially wanted before the drama, the BS and before the bloated industry-related ambitions. I had made some bad hiring choices and some bad design choices and this product will hopefully help rectify that for me and also for fans of the first game. Owners of the first game will have a significant launch discount and more details about this and any other potential rewards/programs will be announced as aspects are cemented down.

https://youtu.be/HZVvc4IVg1M

It is being built on brand new technology and will better support hardware and other platforms. It’ll be privately developed (no crowdfunding or early access) but we will have ways for players to get into possibly Alpha or Beta sessions with details to come later.

https://youtu.be/Eox8rPyOBAg

Mechanically, fundamentally and ethically GOO2 will be a night and day difference compared to GOO1:
• No Loot Crates
• No Micro-Transactions
• No Double Currencies
• No Early Access
• No Crowdfunding 
• No online-focused infrastructure. 

It’ll be a premium game and extremely polished at release.

We want to deliver this for fans of Guardians as we want something that lasts through time as we cannot control player counts and this is something we learned, understand and have factored into future projects. We expect to have Guardians of Orion 2 available for sale as early as summer 2019.


[h1]2. What would you say has been the biggest lesson you’ve learnt since the start of developing games?[/h1]
The most important thing I learned is definitely who you surround yourself with. Because no matter what pulling off any creative or collaborative production is extremely hard, but pulling it off when you have anchors on your ankles with things anywhere between theft or delays makes it that much more impossible. Who you acquaint is who you are, sort of thing.

https://youtu.be/lF6U0bT0Vxo

I don’t want to scare off any aspiring developers as I’ve met hundreds of amazing people, but it only takes a handful to poison the well. Ultimately it’s about finding the right balance with how we go about making future projects. It’s very much the same as designing a game. The culture behind the production dictates the game and it’s just as important if not more so.

The other aspect is you’ll definitely want to focus on a social outlet (Twitch, Amazon, Blog/Vlog/Website, Facebook, Twitter, etc) wherever you have the most or where you’re most comfortable. Do regular updates, start to build up some community around that. Do that for a bit of the early pre-production and production then with that audience go for a crowdfund or early access release that can snowball.

Other options are using a team as a service to generate skill based income. If you’re a 3D artist you can sell on market places. Same holds true for things like VFX, Programming, UI, SFX, 2D, etc. Find a way to generate supplemental income. It’s all about the snowballing effect, whatever small ounce of anything you can get you’ll have to snowball into bigger and better.

In addition to that if you’re able to get to any expos or conferences you can meet lots of partners and fans there and that’s a great crowd as they’re just hardcore enough to the point to even go to those things, so truly passionate and really fun to meet.


[h1]3. As a company you are very open with what you have planned. Do you think this is something more game devs should do?[/h1]
To a degree, it’s a really hard thing to balance that we’ve even failed at this in the past. In ways we will be a bit more reserved than we were in the past and in ways we will be a bit more involved due to the private production of these upcoming video game projects and not using public domains like Crowdfunding or Early Access. We’ve worked hard over the last year re-developing how we will do go about this moving forward.

https://youtu.be/VYaIlnuT00k


[h1]4. Will any of your upcoming games be coming to console?[/h1]
We will always love and support the PC which is where our roots are and most of our fan base but I think you’ll definitely see some ORION on consoles in addition to Linux and Mac support. Accessibility is one of or top priorities and we are very excited to explore platforms in addition to Steam. Frankie and I are huge fans of consoles and the mentality behind them. I grew up with Xbox while she grew up with Playstation and so its a really nice mix.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JsBpYFI.png[/img]

[h1]5. You’ve mentioned a table top video game set in the Orion universe. Do you think you will carry on experimenting with using the same IP in different genres?[/h1]
We are super excited for the Orion table top game. While Guardians of Orion 2 will be a great local and singular experience the true offline and local gameplay is, was and always will be table top games.

This is our first rodeo with table top games and its very different than anything I’ve seen. We think fans of the ORION games will appreciate how fast-paced and over the top it is and we think it fills a really great spot for fans who already enjoy table top games and board games.

Beyond that VR and AR are fascinating as well as Cinematic Stories which would really be full circle as ORION was originally a screenplay before it became a game adaptation.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MdxGtJj.png[/img]
[h1]6. Do you think you will go back and make improvements to GOO and Prelude? Or perhaps let others create mods?[/h1]
ORION: Prelude was officially wrapped in 2015. Guardians in late 2016. Each for their own unique reasons. Prelude ended up doing great via post-release and so we were able to add a lot to that game, more than ever imagined with things like DUEL, VITAL and 10 playable Dinosaurs. 

We do often wish we could update it but the truth is the technology is so old (nearly 10 years at this point), the engine is so old, it’s very messy and ‘freshman’ with many developers having tinkered with it and to be honest it’s very difficult to update even small things at this point.

One of the great learning lessons of Guardians of Orion is that we really cannot control player count at all. We have control over Product, not Player Count and its why you’ll see some big changes in our focuses and designs for Guardians2 and Prelude2.

Ultimately we are pleased with how many users each game reached and Guardians was only disappointing due to how much was invested up front for years and it never recouping that. It has a lot to grow but I’m personally hopeful that we can figure something out where it can hopefully evolve towards self-sustaining and then profitable where I could put a dev or two on it to do a few (smaller) things but the main crew is on other things now, some of which are public and others that are not.


[h1]7. Prelude 2 is now officially in development. Will you use vehicular combat just like in the first game?[/h1]
Player drive-able vehicles WILL be in Prelude2. There are even strong designs of some enemy vehicle units. Guardians2 is also scheduled to have a few vehicle missions which we’re very excited to produce. We have a lot to share as things become more cemented and developed and are also reviewing tons of old user feedback and new user feedback. If you want to share or discuss anything make sure to join the new Orion Discord Channel we’ve set up to do so in addition to meeting other fans, winning prizes and learning game development.

https://youtu.be/w2r7dbKFhJs

[h1]8. What would be your number one tip for any game dev trying to release their game on Steam?[/h1]
Don’t forget to take breaks. It is so important for mental health and just overall well-being. Once release hits so many things snowball and it can be really overwhelming and personally I often put priorities in the wrong place. As a result a better quality you is a better quality product.


[h1]9. GOO or Prelude?[/h1]
I’m really appreciative of both. Even though I wasn’t able to deliver or integrate everything I wanted into both I accomplished so many things that I wanted to learn or experience. I learned a lot from both and there were parts that I very much enjoyed. I still have a blast playing both of them but if I had to pick one it would be Prelude just because I am a huge FPS fan.


[h1]10. Out of the three projects you’re working on, which one are you most excited to be working on?[/h1]
Guardians2 and Prelude2 are going to be very special games and I believe they are going to hit my original expectations for each in wonderful ways.
But I have to go with the board game. It was something so different and new to us that it feels like it did 20 years ago when I first got into modding.

Working on the video game projects is always exciting as its so creative and collaborative but it no longer really has a fear or anxiety associated to it as especially with what we are doing now where production is such a night and day difference than what we did in the past. We have a great idea of how smooth these are really going to go.

The board game is something so fresh and we think we have a really unique offering for fans of table top games that will also be really appealing to fans of the Orion video games that enjoy that over-the-top, fast paced action.

You’ll be hearing a lot about the upcoming board game as it’ll likely be released before either of the two announced projects and it’ll have some really neat behind the scenes showing how the characters are printed, coated and treated, painted and how we actually are going to go about bringing this physical product to life.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/538190/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610/

notes.title: ORION Loyalty Discount
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JsBpYFI.png[/img]

Back in 2015 we decided to honor the backers with a failed crowdfunding and granted them rewards despite not receiving their funds.  This sort of reflected the cycle that enveloped Guardians of Orion not only then but for years to come.  While we wanted to add so much more and were willing to learn the knowledge or skills to deliver the opportunity never came.  

Shortly after the release of 1.0 we knew things weren't in a good place for the product.  We opened up with a transparent update to make the Community aware of this.  We continued adding vast amounts of content based on the original Stretch Goals we wanted to deliver and piece by piece we started to get the infrastructure in there and this included things like Third Person, First Person, Gear, Loot, Inventory, New Guardians, Spaceships, New Modes.  

It eventually came down to the point where we put up a Patreon to simply cover server costs, a campaign that also didn't succeed.  In the end we tried as many things as we possibly could:
1. Crowdfunding (four total)
2. Steam Sales (Summer, Winter)
3. Orion Sales (multiple a year)
4. Steam Events (freeplay w/ discounts)
5. Daily Streams
6. Giveaway Streams (weekly)
7. SteamGifts Giveaways (multiple)
8. Transparency w/ Community
9. Epic Platform Grants
10. Steam Page Promotionals
11. 3rd Party support
12. Partner promotional support

For all the people that keep asking or wanting more GOO1 stuff, so did and do we.  There are only a few methods at this point and the largest ones are unfortunately nulled by the community around the game with things like the review bombs.  I literally just had a huge deal break down simply over the reviews/comments.  It's fine if they all genuinely feel that way but to expect me to be able to work a deal with that is not likely.  

If GOO1 ever becomes self-sustaining we'd look at putting one or two developers on it to do some small things but otherwise key talent is now on other projects and the focus is keeping GOO1 around for all existing fans.

We appreciate all Orion fans who came out to support.  We always will honor that support and this doesn't change going forward.  There will be loyalty tier-based Discounts associated on future titles which DANKIE will be developing internally.  

Moving forward:

THE SEQUEL THAT NOBODY WANTED
We are going to deliver what we initially wanted before the drama, the BS and before the bloated industry-related ambitions.  I had made some bad hiring choices and some bad design choices and this product will hopefully help rectify that for me and also for fans of the first game.  Owners of the first game will be eligible for a significant launch discount.  Join the Discord for more information:
https://discord.gg/RykWMpC

It is being built on brand new technology and will better support hardware and other platforms. 
 Mechanically, fundamentally and ethically GOO2 will be a night and day difference compared to GOO1.  No loot crates, no micro transactions, no double currencies, no Early Access, no Crowdfunding and no online-focused infrastructure.  It'll be a premium game that is privately produced and extremely polished at release.  

We want to deliver this for fans of Guardians as we want something that lasts through time as we cannot control player counts and this is something we learned, understand and have factored into future projects.  There will be a significant focus on Community Tools, SDK and fully offline-ready.

We expect to have Guardians of Orion 2 available for sale as early as summer 2019."


The ORION DANKIE DISCORD features Chat Progression XP which allows you to earn free in-game gear and rewards for Guardians of Orion.  Otherwise feel free to organize games with hundreds of other fans or ask game development questions.
https://discord.gg/RykWMpC

notes.title: Trek Industries - Moving Forward & 2018+
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EMa2YLm.png[/img]
We have some massive changes as we move forward towards 2018 and beyond!
https://youtu.be/tORdJkRPEmA

1. FOCUS
Many aspects and variables have added up to as why we are choosing to and able to double-down.  Ultimately it boils down to the fact that we believe in ORION and are excited for where it is headed.

We will be covering this in much more detail in upcoming weekly updates as we have made some big changes internally and for our upcoming development style.  This includes a roster remastering and ensuring the right fit for the right roles.  We've parted ways with some and had to make harder choices in the past with others.  We wish them all the best and hope they will continue and choose to do great things.  This will be covered in many Behind-The-Scenes with how we bring things to life, including:
Game Design, Production, Programming, Animation, Motion-Capture, Virtual Reality, Music Production & more!
 
We are very excited for ORION.  Many familiar faces will be a part of this new production.  With a few more responsibilities acquired across the board we will have much less chance at having any previous mistakes re-appear.  This is of course better for ORION and us as all we like to do is: Build, Build, BUILD!


2. MIND
This pertains to what we involve ourselves in, directly or indirectly.  We want to cheer the industry on, not segregate it.  While this has always originated from a good place it ultimately ends up confrontational due to the black & white nature of it.  Whether it is journalism or other games - we want other fan bases to be supported in ways we know they can.  In the end we all want these games to succeed, we want them to come out and we want them to evolve with fan feedback.

So how this is changing is mentality.  While we want fans to be taken care of accordingly, it is just not our place or responsibility.  In this day and age there is so much information and access, whether it is about the game itself and what it is, what the experience is, reviews, Let's Plays - Fans have more tools than ever and are wise enough to make their own choices and investments.  It is not our place to try and govern or protect that.

TL;DR
You will see a lot less political stuff and purely more games and behind-the-scenes developments.


3. RELEASE STYLE (2.0 series)
For Guardians of Orion EARLY ACCESS we were doing nearly monthly releases and updates, apart from one or two (1.6 and 2.0).  We will be elongating this to further perfect, smooth out and ensure incredible releases going forward.  Each release will also have a Beta that you may opt in to further help us find any anomalies and resolve.  
· Month1: Raw/New Developments
· Month2: Content Additions
· Month3: Beta, Marketing, Polish+Release


ORION @ STEAM
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

LEARN MORE:
https://youtu.be/2HAjQj-Bdfw
https://youtu.be/UAamjl8YFI4
https://youtu.be/2Ri_Qcz93Bw

notes.title: (UPDATED) Custom Edition (v3.0) ???
notes.content:
[quote](UPDATED Friday, July 21, 2017 @ 9:34AM PT)
Thanks for your feedback!  Always love hearing what you all think.   For v3.0 we're going to avoid this as it doesn't seem largely wanted and we'll continue on the areas already mentioned thus far.  More announcements on the way and thanks to all who participated in feedback~
[/quote]

We are considering a new ("Custom") edition of ORION to coincide with v3.0 that would allow any owner of such to create a CUSTOM HELMET with the Developers.
[Img]http://i.imgur.com/O2YQONk.jpg[/img]

( THE PROCESS )
This would be a very simple process where you would (1) Send 3 inspiration images and (2) we discuss it over  with you directly and (3) Send you progress updates of an early mold, finished mold and then completed.  

( DELIVERY )
The turn-around would likely be 3 months or less considering demand and supply.  Would debut with v3 which is Fall 2018 at the earliest.

( COSTS )
This Custom Edition would be priced to match as it'd be a PRODUCTION item.  Meaning a new digital item would be produced with each purchase. It would have to fully cover the cost of
• The digital helmet itself.
• Factor in all the royalty splits
• Still make us a bit on top to throw back into game production (and eat).  

( PRICING )
We are talking $$$$$+ and with that window of time and how efficiently we can produce them it should level out nicely in that regard.  

( SUPPLY & DEMAND )
Of course if there is increased demand that'd create jobs for new artists and more support for the game itself and new features.

Could be a fun thing for fans and great support for ORION. Would love to hear your thoughts below!  We would love to hear your thoughts below!

notes.title: Trek Industries Answers YOUR Questions About OPEN GALAXY/WORLD (Guardians of Orion v3.0)
notes.content:
We had some great questions about the recently announced Guardians of Orion v3.0 (Open Galaxy/World Module) and so here we answer them!~
[img]http://i.imgur.com/C1uzYHL.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/2HAjQj-Bdfw

[h1]ORION @ STEAM[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/



[h1]GUARDIANS OF ORION v3.0 FAQ PART 1[/h1]

[quote]
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[b]#1 - WHAT DOES IT MEAN BY HOSTILE TERRITORY?[/b]
Many things are subject to change over the course of v3.0 production, but WarGames will be transitioning from a PvP to PvE and dogfighting is planned in other areas and scenarios, possibly including between surface regions!

This includes revisiting systems, module relationships and mechanics to include and compensate for all the new technology and features to make them as accessible as possible!

This includes remastering both WarGames and Mayhem as PvE experiences while we prepare and hopefully get to integrate a *significantly* improved PvP module that we have designed/planned.

"Hostile Territory" displays a new idea we have for dogfighting which would utilize the Open World (and other specific areas) that would allow players to engage in Dynamic Battles between Exploration & Missions.

It is all about finding the right balance of speed & space to make it viable for players who *WANT* PvP battles to remain in those cool areas, but to also make them avoidable enough for players who *DON'T*.

We showed this off via the video above in a complete region transition between RELIC & HAVEN where the dogfighting route is a long, linear canyon (HOOD CANYON) route and you can easily visually follow that to engage in combat OR you can quickly simply cut through it and hop to the region, *especially* with a thruster or booster.  
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#2 - WILL THERE BE A FUEL OR REPAIR SYSTEM?[/b]
This is still subject for debate, but if these elements *do* work their way in it'll be a very minor focus.

For example, ALL Starships are subject to having basic functionality that allows them to travel within Solar Systems and to and from Planets/Moons/Regions.

The only time fuel would likely be factored is if we get to the point of adding OTHER Star Systems (like ours) or other Alien ones.  This would likely cost ION to travel that distance at that speed.  It also may come into effect for quick-travel (menu-based within systems) at the cost of a bit of ION.  

If we ever did repairs it'd either be menu-based (like applying points in the Skill Tree) OR would be a quick fly-through -- think something along the lines of Burnout Paradise repairs where you quickly pull off at intended areas.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#3 - WHERE WOULD THE BEST PLACE BE TO CONTACT YOU GUYS AND START A FEEDBACK DISCUSSION?[/b]
The official Steam Forums for public posts and ( connect(at)trek-industries(dot)com for private posts).
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#4 - AS LONG AS I GET SPLIT-SCREEN FIRST PERSON I AM GOOD... OTHERWISE IT'S ALREADY AN AMAZING GAME![/b]
We have plans for Offline evolution, including new experiences that utilize: Ships, Top-Down, Third-Person and First-Person.  Another Module/Feature we are very excited for is the Campaign which is also in FPS, and would be after the Open World/Galaxy technology is in place (to make use of).
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#5 - STILL MISS GOOD OLD LANDING VIA JUMPING FROM A DROPSHIP?[/b]
Dropships are scheduled to return!  They will first re-debut via Drone Defense PvE by delivering aggressive Robots that want to destroy you.  We also have plans of having a choice-based landing sequence from a variety of options including Pod, Dropship, Starship and more!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#6 - I WANT THIS GAME IN DIFFERENT LANGUAGES, LIKE: FRENCH, SPANISH AND GERMAN... PLEASE![/b]
Localization is important to us!  We are hoping to include a total of 3-5 languages for the mega v3.0 release.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#7 - I'LL ALWAYS HAVE A SWEET SPOT FOR ORION TITLES.  IT'S GREAT TO SEE WORK CONTINUING TOWARDS v3.0[/b]
Thanks!  We believe Guardians of Orion can become "one of the greats" with enough time and support!  We will continue to build it up as best as we can and hope that players will find their way.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#8 - ARE WE STILL GOING TO NEED TO HOARD ION CHUNKS AS A MEANS OF FUEL?[/b]
The most important (scheduled) upcoming use for ION Chunks is currently to be the Celestial Module.  If we do incorporate ION Chunks towards Vehicle Fuel it would likely be an extremely minor focus, apart from QuickTraveling between Star Systems and high energy things like BEAMING/WARPING.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#9 - I THOUGHT ION PROVIDED UNLIMITED FUEL?[/b]
According to lore theory yes that is possible!  But it's an energy that has to be renewed.  The beautiful thing about ION is the amount of energy it can store and the fact/rate at which it can replenish. 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#10 - YOU SHOULD MAKE IT SO WHEN YOU GO OUT OF THE ATMOSPHERE YOU GAIN MORE SPEED SO YOU CAN TRAVEL TO OTHER PLANETS EASIER.[/b]
Lots of this is just intention or placeholder at best.  We will likely modify many aspects including transitional speeds.  We will also be adding many new elements, including: Atmospheric Effects, Hull Burning, Particle Effects, Camera Splines and so much more.  It'll look far more impressive than what is depicted in this video.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#11 - SINCE IT IS OPEN WORLD, DOES THAT MEAN NO LOBBY?  HOW WILL MULTIPLAYER WORK IF THERE IS NO LOBBY?[/b]
We will be going into more detail about how we are bringing this to life as we progress through the production and share Behind The Scenes like we did approaching the v2.0 release.  We are very excited to share this process with you!

The short answer is there will still be Lobbies but you'll be able to join them just as you do now, whether Solo or with a group of friends via a Party.

We also will make use of the Open World/Open Galaxy Technology with the planned (Offline) Campaign.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#12 - SO LONG AS I CAN TRAVEL IN SPACE FROM THE GROUND LIKE NO MAN'S SKY IT'S ALL GOOD, I HATE HOW GAMES FORCE YOU TO CUTSCENES TO SPACE, I'D RATHER DO IT MYSELF?[/b]
We totally agree!  While we will likely be starting the first phase with a locked in-game/in-engine transition we DO hope to open that up to Player-based Free-Flight for the transition over time and with support!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#13 - LOOKS A BIT LIKE NO MAN'S SKY WITHOUT ALL OF THE ROCK COLLECTING, ROCK COLLECTING AND MORE ROCK COLLECTING.  GREAT TO HAVE A LORE-FRIENDLY REASON TO USE THOSE SPACESHIPS[/b]
While our primary focus will be ADVENTURE< EXPLORATION, MISSIONS & TRAVEL - We would like to add secondary-objectives over time in order to fill gaps and maximize pacing.  Including the ability to have features such as Player Housing & Mining.  We are open to additional community-based requests and look forward to seeing all the suggestions!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#14 - MAYBE BIG CARGO SHIPS YOU CAN LAND ON AND THEY HAVE DIFFERENT SUPPLIES?[/b]
We have a Type-3 StarShip in the game (currently passive) and these are planned with future module use such as: NPC's, Missions, Supplies, Player Housing & more!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#15 - ANYTHING TO DO IN SPACE OTHER THAN TRANSPORTING OURSELVES?[/b]
Transportation is just the beginning!  We'd love to add a ton of content to this as we are building the technology and framework "Sandbox" to eventually house features such as Hoverbikes, Mechs, Mining, Dueling, Missions, NPC's, PvP and many more things we'd love to add.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#16 - HUMAN ENEMIS?  SCAVENGERS WOULD BE VERY COOL TO FIGHT![/b]
This is planned!  We want to add a ton of NPC's and A.I life to the game. W e hope to make Social Hubs such as Orbital Command much more lively over time with humans, drones and aliens that come and go based on months.

We've already designed hundreds of critical characters and brought to life over a dozen (check the 4min mark of the video).

Another faction that is planned for addition are the Murdocke Mercenary Forces.  These are human Special Forces groups that would patrol many regions.  We also have plans for Bounty Hunters that you can utilize to put wages (for example 5,000 Credits) on the heads of fellow Guardians.

IF we get to add other Solar Systems (including ours with Earth) there would be room for actual Scavenger and Rebel types and that would be very exciting to visit Earth during the Orion game time lime:
https://youtu.be/VFopklaUqvg
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#17 - SINCE YOU'LL BE ABLE TO ACCESS REGIONS WITH SPACESHIPS,
 DOES THAT MEAN YOU'LL REVAMP THE "START GAME" HOLOGRAM TABLES??[/b]
That is the plan!  We have many new methods of integration for you to hop to and from location and gameplay experience.  Just as you had suspected there *IS* an advanced form of BLINKING called BEAMING and it is basically the same thing but just very long distance and high energy count.  
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#18 - PERSONALLY I WOULD LIKE TO SEE MORE GAMEPLAY MODULES, ESPECIALLY MECHS[/b]
Those are some of our most wanted features as well.  With larger expanses come the greater need for vehicles to take you to and from location.  These modules pave the way for new Spaceships, Hoverbikes, Mechs & more!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#19 - WOULD BE AWESOME IS YOU COULD BUILD BASES ON THEM[/b]
This is something that is planned!  We are very excited for modules including PLAYER HOUSING & BASE BUILDING.  There are so many possibilities once these modules get added to the game that it is mind numbing. We actually had a very small dev alpha prototype put together in 2016 to showcase a rough idea of that:
https://youtu.be/6XIuiYs8y68
https://youtu.be/zGdq_YjKzv4
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b]#20 - WOULD BE AWESOME IS YOU COULD BUILD BASES ON THEM[/b]
This is something that is planned!  We are very excited for modules including PLAYER HOUSING & BASE BUILDING.  There are so many possibilities once these modules get added to the game that it is mind numbing. We actually had a very small dev alpha prototype put together in 2016 to showcase a rough idea of that:
https://youtu.be/6XIuiYs8y68
https://youtu.be/zGdq_YjKzv4

In fact we have an area on Luna 2 (same moon that Orbital Command is on, just a different region, called "ALPHA BASE" that is actually partially developed and a nice open surface intended for Player (Moon) Base creations!


The main focus area of Version 3.0 will be Open World and Open Galaxy gameplay.  

However it'll also include many other critical and massive updates including brand new content and areas of remastered existing content.  The level of evolution will be more drastic from 2.0 to 3.0 than it was from 1.0 (Early Access) to 2.0.  That is saying a lot as 1.0 was a Top-Down only shooter with 3 Guardians and 3 Maps - compared to 9 Guardians, 30+ Maps and 3+ Perspectives!
[/quote]

Have a question?  Comment below!~

notes.title: Signs of Hope
notes.content:
Based on increasing fan support, there appears to be an opportunity for active development to resume on Guardians of Orion in the upcoming future.  
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NuBpOaE.png[/img]

[h1]GUARDIANS OF ORION![/h1]
While the daily and monthly active users are remaining mostly the same, the backend support has slightly improved.  
https://youtu.be/2Ri_Qcz93Bw

[h1]( ADDITIONAL MONITORING REQUIRED )[/h1]
While it still has a ways to go and we are currently continuing to evaluate product performance, server optimization AND working in the background to further promote and maximize awareness towards ORION in hopes of further growing and evolving it.  Join us every Sunday on Twitch.TV!
https://www.twitch.tv/dprassel


[h1]( UP TO TEN YEARS )[/h1]
Our first game, ORION: Prelude was a 5 year development cycle.  We have discussed in the past how we want Guardians of Orion to be a 10 year development cycle for everything we'd love to accomplish.  However this is only one part of the pie as this is our willingness to re-invest, learn,  master and deliver.  This is all an energy that has to run off of a fuel which is fan support as an independent game developer.  This is all up to you!  So whether we get 2 years or 10 years is up to you, we want the 10 :)


[h1]( SPREAD THE WORD, IT IS WORKING )[/h1]
So if a few months were quiet in the grand scheme of things this will never really matter and the best way to continue to grow the game and support the game is to:
1. Share with Friends
2. Post on Forums/Groups/Pages you frequent (if allowed)
3. Use Social Media (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, etc)
4. Contact influencers you follow (Streamers, YouTubers, Website Reviewers)


[h1]( FUTURE FOCUS AREAS )[/h1]
Through fan-interaction via our weekly Twitch Streams we can see that the big focus areas you all want include, but are not limited to:
· Offline Progression/Evolution
· More Servers
· New Menus
· New Guardians
· New Enemies


[h1]( AVOIDANCE AREAS )[/h1]
The things that had upset you the most during Year 1 development of Guardians of Orion, include:
· Inventory Issues (Summer 2016)
· Servers/Connection Issues (Summer 2016)
· Progression Save Issues (Summer 2016)
· Early Access Reset (Winter 2016)


We'd love to hear more of your feedback, suggestions and comments.  If you feel like you'd like to see something else content/focus wise please list it below!
[h1]What do you want to see/find to be most critical to include in the future Guardians of Orion update[/h1]


[h1]Keep up the great work and see you in Space~[/h1]

notes.title: Server Improvements
notes.content:
We've got intel to share.  Prepare for briefing, Guardian!

[h1]THANKS FOR THE FEEDBACK![/h1]
We started receiving user reports late Wednesday evening (4/12/2017) regarding issues pertaining to server loading or connectivity, lagely regarding Inventories, Currencies or Levels.  After replicating the issue on our end we began an immediate investigation and contacted all appropriate partners.  Luckily the problem is going to be resolved and we've some information to share!

https://youtu.be/rAeXxQ4x6Xk
https://youtu.be/qmjYrb_sXg0

[h1]MOST IMPORTANTLY[/h1]
All of your Items, Currency and Levels are OK.  They are still on the backend, registered and SAFE.  If you're not seeing anything it is 100% a visual-only error.  Do not stress, nothing was lost!

[h1]THE NITTY GRITTY[/h1]
The server that some of these games were on ran a few instances that first day it was on, and then for some reason, rebooted.  Doing so put it into an Unavailable state.  Our server backend partner has terminated it at this point so it's been cleaned up now.  Our backend partner is currently working on a new update that will kill any server that does this so it will be prevented fully in the future.

To address this in the immediate our server backend partner has increased the rate for our title meaning there aren't currently any failure cases right now.  If there are, please report it to us immediately and we will have them investigate.  They are actively monitoring and updating.

[h1]REGARDING INVENTORY-LOAD ISSUES[/h1]
They have detecting occassional read-throttling in the backend due to extremely large inventories and grants of large numbers of items - AKA LOOT!  This is because of how they process it which favors predictability and safety over response time.  This will affect larger inventories and in extreme cases it will add latency for loading.  This will be entirely true for anyone with stackables in high amounts.  

[h1]SOME SOLUTIONS[/h1]
To address these issues in the immediate they have increased our throttle rate to help compensate.  They have additional optimizations that they are scheduled to roll out this week to help reduce it even further.  

Stay tuned and as always if you experience anything irregular or run into any issues please contact us directly:
connect@trek-industries.com (ideas/general)
support@trek-industries.com (bugs/technical support)

notes.content:
[h1]VERSION 2.05 - READY FOR RELEASE[/h1]
We are thrilled to announce that the Official Release of v2.05 is now available for download! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/UHQ945h.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sCZi6Pj.jpg[/img]

[h1]VERSION 2.05 - PLAY FOR FREE[/h1] (Ends March 27)

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840


[h1]VERSION 2.05 - WHAT IS INSIDE?[/h1]
This is a massive and community-focused update.  We've remastered the entire experience, optimized everything, double the PvE content and gave all 30+ regions a visual improvement!  It looks better AND runs better!
[quote]
[list]
[*] We've given all users 6 free helmets, inspired by ORION Dino Beatdown and ORION: Prelude.
[*] We've upgraded a majority of user accounts.  Login to see!
[*] We've re-added the fan-favorite Survival game mode.
[*] We've awarded a LEVEL 50 Booster for you to give to any Guardian.
[*] We've changed the Difficulty/Gear system.
[*] We've added Supportive XP gains.
[*] We've increased XP Progression.
[*] We've buffed Weapon Damages.
[*] We've increased gear drop rates.
[*] We've resolved issues with Crafting.
[*] We've resolved issues with Joining/Creating certain types of games.
Most importantly - it's fun!
[/list]
[/quote]


[h1]VERSION 2.05 - LOOT CRATE CHALLENGE[/h1]
We are going to start a new weekly event for Guardians of Orion called the LOOT CRATE CHALLENGE. These are scheduled to occur every Sunday starting this upcoming one! 
https://youtu.be/GauU5mJEE0c

[b]( LOOT CRATE CHALLENGE #1 )[/b]
VERSION: 2.05
DATE: March 26, 2017
MODE: Mayhem FFA
TIMES:
[list]
[*] 9am US Pacific
[*] 11am US Central
[*] Noon Eastern
[*] 4pm London
[/list]
[/quote]

This challenge will be 100% focused on the PvP modes of Guardians of Orion, including Mayhem FFA (Planetside) and WarGames FFA (Dogfighting). There will be multiple winners, each who will win 10 Loot Crates!
https://youtu.be/DdSOTd1KGn4

[quote]
[b]( THE RULES )[/b]
The rules are simple! All about the rank!
[list]
[*] 1st Place = 10 Gold Loot Crates (40 Items)
[*] 2nd Place = 10 Silver Loot Crates (40 Items)
[*] 3rd Place = 10 Bronze Loot Crates (40 Items)
[/list]
[/quote]

So start practicing in PvP and get ready for the
#gooLOOT

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QYikTos.jpg[/img]

You will auto-upgrade to Elite Edition status on release+login of v2.05.
Issues?  Contact founder@trek-industries.com

[h1]VERSION 2.05 - STARTER EDITION[/h1]
We are excited to launch the third edition of Guardians of Orion: The Starter Edition!

This new entry maintains the fan-favorite $1 model while offering more than we were ever able to previously. This new edition will be launching alongside the upcoming v2.05. You may read more about current and former editions right here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/343785574521070493/

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2YRdrVt.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UHftSUr.jpg[/img]


[h1]VERSION 2.05 - ELITE INVENTORY UPGRADE[/h1]
All Elite Edition owners, both existing and via the v2.05 User Account Upgrades, now have 200 Inventory Slots instead of 100.  We hope you enjoy!  For any non-Elite Edition owners you may visit the Trek Store at Orbital Command to acquire Inventory Slot upgrades.

[h1]LOVING GOO[/h1]
We'd absolutely love to support Guardians of Orion- for years to come!  We have a lot of resources and money invested in the technology behind Guardians of Orion and the sky is the limit in regards to what our technology can produce mixed with the ambition of the team.  But it doesn't matter how beautiful the car is or what features it has if it has no fuel in the tank.

The reality is that Guardians of Orion has had three failed crowdfunding campaigns, each where no money was raised and demand/support was not there.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/77dgfPH.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FGhHPMM.jpg[/img]

[quote]
In 2014 we launched a crowdfunding campaign for a pre-production version.  This event failed.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/the-orion-project
In 2015 we launched a crowdfunding campaign for a Production version.  This event failed.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion
In 2016 we launched a crowdfunding campaign for a near-complete version. This event failed.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/orion-sci-fi-open-galaxy-mmorpg-shooter
[/quote]

Despite this we took it as far as possible and funded it to a late 2015 Steam Early Access release.  Using revenue from other investments and products we continued to support it to an official release with significantly more content.  While this resides on us for this level of care and investment, it is only because we love and believe in our games as illustrated with our first game, ORION: Prelude:
https://youtu.be/ShQ3GBFI4KQ

[b]2012 to 2017[/b]
This is a much different experience compared to our first game, ORION: Prelude, which was able to fortunately raise a large chunk of development money at the initial release back in May 2012.  This allowed us to understand what we had to work with and forecast it across the next two years.  This is what permitted us to use those resources to grow the game from something everyone hated into one of the best indie co-op shooters of all time.

In comparison, Guardians of Orion has been costing/losing us money since 2014 when pre-production began and we can only keep it alive for so long from only within as a small independent developer.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Oh4XzMj.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5PcD2Kk.jpg[/img]

[b]HOW TO HELP[/b]
We've been talking for a while now (nearly a year) about how Guardians of Orion has simply not been performing as well as our first game, nor to a point where it is standing on its own financially: 
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d4xTOR88DdQ
http://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/814405427470627707

Guardians of Orion would need to cover its own infrastructure and production let alone generate actual profit in order for us to have the ability to produce content for the game and that is and always will be up to the gaming community!

[b]COMMUNITY-FOCUSED[/b]
We've really listened to the community and remastered and refocused a lot of content and systems in the game for v2.05 release.  Feedback from the v2.05 Open Beta has been largely positive and we hope for a successful Official Release!

Any major future content updates for Guardians of Orion has always and will always remain in your hands.  We hope you love it, and if you do we ask that you tell someone!  Write or update a review, upload a screenshot!  Do whatever you think is worth it and are comfortable with and show your support.  The more you support us the more we can support you! 

[b]STEAM EVENT[/b]
We will do what we can within our power to generate awareness and our largest event for Guardians of Orion begins this Monday on March 20, 2017.  This is a Steam Free-2-Play event allowing ANYONE with a Steam account to experience the entire game (v2.05) in all of its glory.  This is a no-risk opportunity to promote the game to friends.

[b]GET SATISFIED[/b]
If you know anyone who enjoys gaming experiences such as Mass Effect, Destiny, Halo, Diablo or Gears of War then Guardians of Orion is a must-own Steam title which can be purchased for as low as $1 starting March 20th courtesy of the STARTER EDITION.

[h1]ORION @ STEAM[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/538190/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610/

The more support we receive the more we can support YOU!  Here's to Year 2!
https://youtu.be/iuGz9YPNNP0

<3 Trek

[h1]v2.05 Open Beta (Round 4) Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed inventory initial gear coloring.
[*] Removed gravity grenade ability from affecting the Harvester.
[*] Increased level of dropped Gear.
[*] Added DoubleXP for ALL account types until April 17th, 2017.
[*] Fixed Privacy Settings not working properly.
[*] Fixed deaths/spawns from the Agora Fire Temple.
[*] Fixed Master Volume audio issues.
[/list]
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Step 1: You must own Guardians of Orion.
[*] Step 2: Open your Steam Library and right-click on Guardians of Orion.

[*] Step 4: Select 'goov205' from the drop-down menu and let the update download and install.

notes.title: GOO v2.05 Beta (Round 2) Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1][UPDATE @ 9:43am US STEAM TIME][/h1]
We've gathered a ton of feedback regarding Guardians of Orion v2.05 Public Beta thanks to the community and we want to run a second round with some updated fixes to gauge anything that remains before the Official Release.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/mDHiffX.png[/img]

[b]GOO v2.05 Beta Round 2 is now available![/b]
https://youtu.be/VYaIlnuT00k

[h1]HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/h1]
[quote]
[list]
Step 1: You must own Guardians of Orion.
Step 2: Open your Steam Library and right-click on Guardians of Orion.
Step 3: Select Properties and then click the 'Beta' tab.
Step 4: Select 'goov205' from the drop-down menu and let the update download and install.
[/list]
[/quote]

[h1]v2.05 ROUND 2 CHANGELOG[/h1]
[quote]
We've addressed a few things including:
[list]
[*] Games around LvL 300 not being able to be created.
[*] Orb power color not resetting after completion.
[*] Issues with gear/level scaling and lower level enemies doing way more dmg than intended.
[*] Issues with the Ion Store and currency exchange.
[*] Issues with crafting items over LvL 600.
[*] Fixed performance issues on Antar region.
[*] Fixed layout issues on Agora region.
[/list]
[/quote]


[h1]FROM DAVID[/h1]
[quote]
"I want to apologize for the reset in late 2016.  It is something we never wanted to do nor intended to do.  While there was an exploit that was abused by some fans, the exploit only existed or came to creation because of us, the developers.

We were going too hard and too fast out of ambition and excitement for the game and what we knew it would become.  Because of this things had slipped through the cracks.

Ultimately I am responsible for what makes it public and because of that I've updated the development model for 2017 and going forward.  Something that will be more comfortable for those inside of it and something that will result in a more polished experience for those who support it.

We've worked very hard on Guardians of Orion v2.05 and the rewards and perks associated.  We truly hope you love what you play.  Please feel free to leave any feedback or connect with us directly"
connect@trek-industries.com
[/quote]

We will be monitoring the performance and community feedback for the beta period of v2.05.

[h1]GUARDIANS OF ORION @ STEAM[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610/

notes.title: Guardians of Orion (v2.05) Trek Love Package
notes.content:
With the release of Guardians of Orion v2.0 (December 21, 2016) we had to reset some critical systems due to discoveries of both the community and us as the developers. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cMjDnjp.png[/img]

The largest culprit was a deep-rooted inventory bug that would allow players to create items (including real currency) out of thin air.  

https://youtu.be/5Gd3JIvZRqU

There were confirmed reports of many participating in this and it had went on for months before being reported to us to resolve.  This means that whatever had caused or created the initial bug had months of other changes and work stacked on top of it.  The only way we could remedy it in a way that was secure and trustworthy was to completely re-do the inventory system from the ground up.  This resulted and required a full wipe on ALL accounts, including DevAccounts.  

We know this was a very hard pill to swallow and it's what stemmed the creation of the Rewards Card and the upcoming Trek Love Package via the upcoming v2.05 game update.

[h1]TREK LOVE PACKAGE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Monthly XP Booster (stacks on an existing booster if available)
[*] 1 Million ION
[*] 3,000 TC
[*] 50 Enhanced Mats
[*] 30 Super Enhanced Mats
[*] 20 Legendary Mats
[/list]

[i]Guardians of Orion v2.05 is scheduled for release in March 2017.  Make sure to login before then to participate in this rewards program![/i]


[h1]GUARDIANS OF ORION @ STEAM[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610/

notes.title: Guardians of Orion (v2.05) User Account Upgrades
notes.content:
Do you have a Guardians of Orion account?  Interested in one for the future?  Some massive user upgrades are happening with the upcoming v2.05 game update!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610/

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2FLVAzB.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/A62Sb9Yxg3U

[h1]V2.05 - EXISTING ACCOUNT UPGRADES[/h1]
We are thrilled to announce perks for ALL account types

Early Access Supporters (2015-Present)
You will auto-upgrade to Pioneer Edition status on release+login of v2.05.

Pioneer Edition Supporters (Dec 21, 2016 - Present)
You will auto-upgrade to Elite Edition status on release+login of v2.05.

Elite Edition Supporters (2016-Present)
You will receive 50,000 Store Credits + 5,000,000 ION.


[h1]V2.05 - STARTER EDITION ANNOUNCED[/h1]
We are excited to launch the third edition of Guardians of Orion: The Starter Edition!

This new entry maintains the fan-favorite $1 model while offering more than we were ever able to previously.  This new edition will be launching alongside the upcoming v2.05.  You may read more about current and former editions right here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/343785574521070493/

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/oueQE8j.jpg[/IMG]

[h1]V2.05 - NEW ACCOUNT MODELS[/h1]
Moving forward there are some backend platform updates occurring that we want to better position ourselves globally across all markets.  We will be adjusting the pricing models to better position it globally across all currencies to have them more in sync.  All new prices will go into effect alongside the release of v2.05 in March 2017.

1. STARTER EDITON ($1 USD)
2. PIONEER EDITION ($10 USD)
3. ELITE EDITION ($50 USD)

More updates, news and perk/reward announcements coming next week!

notes.title: Progression Issues & Memory Leaks Discovered & Resolved
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cluQIEO.png[/img]

We're nearing the release of Guardians of Orion v2.05!  
https://youtu.be/QTvp3QltoXQ

This is a fantastic update that will introduce incredible new Harvest/PvE regions, the return of the Survival game mode, updated progressions, optimizations and so much more!  We will cover additional details as the release draws even closer!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bGv0ztC.png[/img]


[h1]( PROGRESSION ISSUE DISCOVERED+RESOLVED )[/h1]
We found an issue that was globally affecting all progression systems and reducing the amount granted compared to what should have been given.  This is resolved via v2.05!


[h1]( INCREASED PROGRESSION )[/h1]
We've also scaled up the progression aspects of the game on top of this!  Easy and Normal remain the same but the later difficulties (Hard, Insane, Redikulous) will have you leveling faster than before - significantly so with the above fix!


[h1]( MEMORY LEAKS )[/h1]
We discovered a bunch of memory leaks relating to items and variables not being removed from players when they leave a game.  This is resolved via v2.05.

[quote]
Trek Industries is a technology and software company focused on interaction and community-based development.  In addition we will be extending our resources into generating advancements and awareness into other sectors including energy, A.I and environmental conservation // www.trek-industries.com

Guardians of Orion is a constantly growing and evolving game.  Originally launching as a Top-Down Retro Shooter only just a year ago (Dec 1, 2015) and having evolved into a First-Person, Third-Person Space-Based MMORPG Shooter.   We already have big plans of what we'd love to do and cannot wait to see what the fans think and suggest!
