The model was subbed out for the official release, as always intended.


(PRIMAL CARNAGE ARTWORK)
Another incident involved a freelancing concept artist.  Back in the day we had an additional folder on our shared Dropbox called "Mood Art".  This would contain anything that was either very "Orionish" or something I wanted to get added to the game and consisted of orion-related fan art, things we'd find online.  Said artist utilized a piece of artwork from that folder and used it as a base layer, proportionally, to do a full new drawing on top of.  

When submitted to me, I didn't know this at the time.  However Ashton, the former head of Primal contacted me right after we made the news post and we took it down immediately and apologized right then and I also personally apologized in person at a conference.  They did not accept it.  Fun fact, years later the two Dinosaur 3D Artists, Tim M and Eugen T, would join and create the Dinosaurs for both Prelude and most of Guardians of Orion - only for me to find out that they were having payment issues at Lukewarm for their completed content.


(WE FIRED PEOPLE)
This is the name of the game.  We work remotely and independently, so sometimes talent doesn't work out.  However it wasn't purely related to strangers and anyone that steals or tries to steal hardware, money or do other shady things doesn't have a place at Trek.  More on that here:
http://artistryingames.com/spiraling-control-incredible-journey-spiral-game-studios/
[/quote]


[h1]An Update[/h1]
An additional update is available. For the record, I (-David) don't agree with this nor believe it's a good use of a small teams resources to immediately replace any asset. 

I was just contacted by the artist responsible (he just woke up to all of this - Eastern part of the world) for the Automatic Shotgun (which is what appears most in fans-submitted comparisons) feels absolutely horrible and has contacted me to inform me that he would feel more comfortable in remaking said weapon regardless of what I do about Activision or how we proceed. So no matter what happens going forward, that weapon will be visually different. 

He feels terrible that his piece of art resulted in these events that have affected so many things and he has started production on it this evening to remedy anything he can do directly. 

- - - - - 

In the end, what Activision is claiming isn't a valid or legal use of DMCA.  If they were alleging that we had actually RIPPED the Black Ops 3 weapons FROM their game and used them exactly - their shipped meshes, their shipped textures - that is a DMCA case.

What they are alleging is that our very own, separately created content is "too visually" or "artistically similar".  That is *NOT* what the DMCA covers.  That is a form of copyright and IP infringement dispute.  Their lawyers know this, but filed this anyways. 

We will be seeking resolution for all damages wrongly inflicted by us FROM Activision via this malicious and overly aggressive tactic.  

Our desire to remove said content is purely for our own benefit. We are a small indie team, any minute the game is not for sale during the biggest event is a stake to the heart.  Us willing to remove any offensive content and to get it back for sale is to protect our selves, our company and our IP.

notes.title: Our Official Response
notes.content:
[h1]The Facts[/h1]
I received the DCMA request after its removal from Steam with no warning/contact from either Valve/Steam or any developer associated with Call of Duty nor anyone from Activision.

I never was provided specific examples of assets, or screenshots of what offended them - nor given the chance to rectify or remove any offensive content prior to having our game removed from sale.

We assumed which pieces of content based on what they self-labeled of their own as well as community-provided assets.

(Comparison 1 - Auto Shotgun)
http://i.imgur.com/8Qx1NI2.png
(Comparison 2 - Auto Rifle)
http://i.imgur.com/IjS7dfO.png

http://i.imgur.com/ZQeBNGs.png

We immediately offered to remove ANY offensive content (as it wasn't specified) and this was not accepted.  


[h1]The Events[/h1]
I was informed by Steam that accordingly to their policy, Activision has 10 business days (until July 7th, 2016 - basically a month due to the Holiday) to act or do anything.  

If Steam doesn't receive a copy of a legal complaint within 10 business days, then our game will be re-instated.

What this means is that Activision has maliciously and erroneously used a DMCA request to aggressively attack a small, independent development team during the BIGGEST Sale Event of the entire year, the Steam Summer Sale.


[h1]Our Comments[/h1]
The sight is the only similarity we can see. Even if it was a 1:1, that's not enough for a design infraction, even by legal standards and by a significant amount.

http://i.imgur.com/ZQeBNGs.png

And the sight is just a futuristic M1 Garand, so either way both are homaging a real world property, the only thing that could actually hold up and is the only one without a dog in this fight.

Regardless, an invalid and malicious act from Activision on wrong or non-existant evidence. They are are multi-billion dollar company coming over what is currently a 50 cent game, without contacting us or requesting anything of us NOR providing any specific assets or images of the offensive content to begin with

That being said, if our community finds our weapons or content offensive we are of course always listening and will integrate feedback/suggestions based on such. If you want weapons changed, we are a developer that reads what you write. We've demonstrated this for many years now across a variety of products:

ORION
https://youtu.be/BbL9MioMpF8

ORION: Prelude
https://youtu.be/ShQ3GBFI4KQ


The Non-Specific DMCA:
DMCA Takedown Notice on your item
 
Valve received a DMCA copyright take down notice about your game, Orion, on Steam at http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/.

*REDACTED*, on behalf of Activision, alleges that the game Orion uses weapon art content from Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 and Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.  The weapon art in question includes the M8A7 rifle, the Haymaker rifle, and the Bal-27 rifle.  Use of this weapon art content without permission infringes Activision’s copyright in Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 and Call of Duty:  Advanced Warfare. https://www.activision.com/games/call-of-duty/call-of-duty-black-ops-3,https://www.activision.com/games/call-of-duty/call-of-duty-advanced-warfare.

As a result, we have removed your posting from Steam.  

Valve follows the procedure set forth in the Digital Millennium Copyright Act. The DMCA is a United States copyright law that governs online service provider liability in case of copyright infringement.  When we receive a DMCA notice, Valve must take down allegedly infringing copyright materials; otherwise Valve could be subject to a claim of copyright infringement.[/quote]


[h1]In Short[/h1]
Orion is a game all about homages.  It's what it's always been, since it was announced as a retro homage to the classic 90's games with a modern take.  It’s GI Joes action figures versus your Jurassic Park toys. It’s Halo meets Turok.  It's what we all did as kids in our heads.

Regardless what it was over, the most important thing was that we were not warned, contacted by either party nor able to remedy it. We offered immediately to remove any offensive content right off the bat, this was rejected.

notes.title: "He Changed The Name Again!!!"
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3Fy0PA3.png[/img]

So nefarious, I know.  I must be trying to hide all those review scores that don't exist!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z-tvgi0ZzPo

[h1]Long Story, Short[/h1]
In a serious note:
[list]
[*] Guardians of Orion was a code name used at the time it was protecting the Orion IP/TOP design from partners and deals.

[*] The Orion Project is a code name used to illustrate an all-inclusive project with all things Orion-related into it.

[*] Orion is the short-hand version of that, in a one-word form which is what I want for the game going forward and when looking back at it in the future.
[/list]


[h1]That Other Game[/h1]
In regards to Dino Beatdown/Horde/Prelude, you can read more on that here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/104900/discussions/0/616188473087907557/
[quote]
They are not sequels, nor "new games". They are simply pieces of a massive (and singular) puzzle that is now complete.

Long story short ORION: Prelude (Competitive PvP) was the original game announced in 2010, a spiritual successor to the ORION: Source Beta. It was not able to release due to a series of events and we had to focus on a smaller scaled experience. This was called Dino Beatdown (Open World Co-Op). It was a disaster and so we continued to work on improving it using the revenue made and the next massive chunk was ORION: Dino Horde (Arena PvP, Duel). 

With the success of Dino Horde we were finally were able to deliver the experience originally promised (Prelude) back in 2010. And then some - considering the original Prelude was to be strictly PvP and only have three game modes (CTF, Vital, Deathmatch) compared to it's modern day predecessor (15 game modes and a variety of play styles). Comparison:

Original Prelude / Modern Prelude
3 Modes / 15 Modes
5 Dinosaurs / 10 Dinosaurs (All Playable)
30 Weapons&Gear / 50 Weapons&Gear
5 Multiplayer Maps / 20+ Multiplayer Maps & SDK

It is now called ORION: Prelude because it *finally* is ORION: Prelude.

You can read the full story / reasoning here:
http://artistryingames.com/spiraling-control-incredible-journey-spiral-game-studios/
[/quote]

[h1]Don't Worry, Be Happy[/h1]
[b]For users who have trouble with name changes, you may rejoice as there are no more words left to remove and this is the very last one.[/b]

notes.title: The Elite Package - Coming June 23, 2016
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/N5xrpOe.jpg[/img]

We are getting very close to the release of The Elite Package for The Orion Project (scheduled for June 23, 2016) and I wanted to take some time and gather everything I can about it to give the most up-to-date information regarding it now that it's mostly developed and integrated into the game.  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z-tvgi0ZzPo

[h1]Q1 - WHAT IS THE ELITE PACKAGE?[/h1]
It is a brand new way to experience Orion and earn exclusive content and gear all while supporting Developers who will get to support you even more as a result.  

The Elite Package is $100 for new comers and only $50 for existing Founder Access members.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/17WFY2w.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QerZf2T.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8Z6fvcA.png[/img]


[h1]Q2 - WHAT DOES THE ELITE PACKAGE INCLUDE?[/h1]
The Elite Package includes a variety of starting content.  We also are scheduled to add additional exclusive items for Elite owners on a regular basis.  The base package will launch with
[quote]
[list]
[*]· Loot Leveling System (Items as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS)
[*]· 50% Store Savings* 
[*]· 10,000,000 Starting Ion 
[*]· Access to the first 20 Guardians 
[*]· Exclusive Elite Armor 
[*]· Exclusive Elite Helmet 
[*]· Exclusive Elite Cloak 
[*]· Exclusive Pet 
[*]· Exclusive Game Icon
[/list]

* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners. All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount. 

*The Elite Package is expected to launch Summer 2016. 
[/quote]


[h1]Q3 - WHAT ARE LOOT LEVELS?[/h1]
This is a new progression system exclusively created for The Elite Package.  This rewards a variety of Loot Crates (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and allows you to UNLOCK Store Items rather than have to purchase them.  This is called EliteXP, otherwise also known as Loot Leveling.

https://youtu.be/o1TvKFgFATM
[quote]
You can make progress on your EliteXP in a variety of ways, with each earned Loot Level unlocking a new crate:
[list]
[*] EliteXP users will earn 10,000 Elite XP every hour of gameplay.  This will be limited to 10,000 EliteXP per single game.
[*] Various amounts of EliteXP are granted for Wins/Losses, all dependent on which Difficulty is being played.
[*] Future modules will also support EliteXP/LootLevels, including the upcoming PvP Modules.

Welcome to Orion.
See you in Space!

notes.title: Are You ELITE??
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RqDbbxv.png[/img]
The Elite Package is coming soon!  It features exclusive items and rewards and will allow you to further support the games production and the team behind it.


[h1]( THE ELITE PACKAGE )[/h1]
We are scheduled to offer a new version of The Orion Project which will be the Elite Package.  This will retail for $100 towards new owners and only a $50 upgrade option available for Founders if they wish to do so as it is NOT required. 
[quote]
[b]Elite Package Details[/b]
· Armors/Hats/Helmets/Skins as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS
· 50% Store Savings*
· 10,000,000 Starting Ion
· Access to the first 20 Guardians
· Exclusive Elite Armor
· Exclusive Elite Helmet
· Exclusive Elite Cloak
· Exclusive Pet
· Exclusive Game Icon
[/quote]
[i]* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners.  All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount.

*The Elite Package is expected to launch Summer 2016.[/i]

[h1]( THE ELITE ARMOR )[/h1]
Inspired and paying homage to the likes of the Nano Suit & Kylo Ren.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YMOSaPe.png[/img]

[h1]( THE ELITE TRENCH COAT ) [/h1]
Inspired and paying homage to the likes of Gambit & Star Lord.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UfZfJ3Y.jpg[/img]

[h1]( THE ELITE PET )[/h1]
Your own personal 'lil buddy - T.O.D - or the Tactical Oblierator Drone.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oIMLHtvh.jpg[/img]

[h1]( SAVE BIG )[/h1]
Starting at the end of this month, you will be able to, as both Standard and Founder, save big money on upgrading to Elite. This will be a one-time, massive saving's event allowing both types of Players to save 50% on the sticker price!  So instead of $100 and $50 it will be $50 and $25.  Make sure to tell your friends, as it will never be priced lower!


[h1]( LOOT CRATES & LOOT LEVELS )[/h1]
Loot Crates are coming to both versions of the game, Standard & Elite.  For the Standard version of the game all three versions of the Loot Crate will be available at the Trek Store for the following prices:
· Bronze Crate: $1
· Silver Crate: $5
· Gold Crate: $10

For the Elite Package, these Crates are unlocked at Leveling intervals courtesy of a new LOOT LEVELING system specific to the Elite Version.  Bronze unlocks *every* level while Silver is unlocked on the 5th and Gold on the 10th interval.  

These Loot Crates can contain a variety of item types, including but not limited to: Weapon Skins, Armor Skins, Hats, Helmets, Armors, Particle Skins, Ion, Credits and many more types of content that we will add over time.  Each category of crate holds a different amount of items inside.

- - - 
[h1] ( FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS )[/h1]
I've also gathered as many community questions regarding The Elite Package as I could and have posted the answers below:
[quote]
[B]Q1 - Will the Open Galaxy Module be Premium?[/B]
No! Open Galaxy is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Guardian Starship. The only premium content related to this module are additional Starships at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance.

[B]Q2 - Will the Mech Module be Premium?[/B]
No! The Mech Module is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Mech unit for EACH class (Light, Meidum, Heavy) as well as the Mech Weapons.. The only premium content related to this module are additional Mechs at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance.

[B]Q3 - Does this in any way affect the present for Founders/Standard owners?[/B]
No - everything is the same, as it was before the announcement.

[B]Q4 - Are there any differences going into the future for Founders/Standar owners?[/B]
Everything is the same except that Loot Crates are announced for the Store.  These can be PAID or PLAYED for.

[B]Q5 - Do you need a Key to unlock said Loot Crates?[/B]
Gross, absolutely not.

[B]Q7 - If I have Founder Access, is it worth it to upgrade to Elite?[/B]
To be honest, probably not for most and it was designed this way.  The only major differences between Elite and Founder are the exclusive cosmetic items, 10 games worth of Ion equalling $1 and the biggest addition which is the confirmation/inclusion of the first 20 Guardians.  That last part may be the only part that would be worth it to YOU the player.  However this is also an option for people that do love exclusive items or simply want to support us in that way.

[B]Q8 - Will the Elite program ever go away?[/B]
It is scheduled to be around permanently.

[B]Q9 - When will the Elite program begin?[/B]
No official date just yet, working on getting Version 1.5 out to the public and we will have more details.

[B]Q10 - Founders can upgrade for $50 instead of $100?[/B]
Yes that is correct.

[B]Q11 - Is there a limit to how long Founders can do the $50 upgrade?[/B]
It is scheduled to be permanent.

[B]Q12 - If I upgrade to Elite and get unlocks instead of purchases, what happens to my already-achieved Levels per Guardian?[/B]
Originally there was no retro-active reward.  But we will find a way to honor already-completed levels using the announced model (Bronze/Silver/Gold crate distribution).

[B]Q13 - Will the 20 Guardians towards Elite be available to other owners (Standard/Founders)?[/B]
Absolutely - they will use the same Store.

[B]Q14 - If I am a Founder with 50% Savings already and upgrade to Elite with that 50% stack for 100% Savings?[/B]
Of course not.

[B]Q15 - Is the Elite Pet faster or better in any way?[/B]
No it just looks different, cosmetic only.  No Pay-2-Win!
[/quote]

The Orion Project
$1 or $100
Play Your Way
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

Your own personal 'lil buddy - T.O.D - or the Tactical Oblierator Drone.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oIMLHtvh.jpg[/img]

[h1]( SAVE BIG )[/h1]
Starting at the end of this month, you will be able to, as both Standard and Founder, save big money on upgrading to Elite. This will be a one-time, massive saving's event allowing both types of Players to save 50% on the sticker price!  So instead of $100 and $50 it will be $50 and $25.  Make sure to tell your friends, as it will never be priced lower!


[h1]( LOOT CRATES & LOOT LEVELS )[/h1]
Loot Crates are coming to both versions of the game, Standard & Elite.  For the Standard version of the game all three versions of the Loot Crate will be available at the Trek Store for the following prices:
· Bronze Crate: $1
· Silver Crate: $5
· Gold Crate: $10

For the Elite Package, these Crates are unlocked at Leveling intervals courtesy of a new LOOT LEVELING system specific to the Elite Version.  Bronze unlocks *every* level while Silver is unlocked on the 5th and Gold on the 10th interval.  

These Loot Crates can contain a variety of item types, including but not limited to: Weapon Skins, Armor Skins, Hats, Helmets, Armors, Particle Skins, Ion, Credits and many more types of content that we will add over time.  Each category of crate holds a different amount of items inside.

- - - 
[h1] ( FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS )[/h1]
I've also gathered as many community questions regarding The Elite Package as I could and have posted the answers below:
[quote]
[B]Q1 - Will the Open Galaxy Module be Premium?[/B]
No! Open Galaxy is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Guardian Starship. The only premium content related to this module are additional Starships at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance.

[B]Q2 - Will the Mech Module be Premium?[/B]
No! The Mech Module is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Mech unit for EACH class (Light, Meidum, Heavy) as well as the Mech Weapons.. The only premium content related to this module are additional Mechs at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance.

[B]Q3 - Does this in any way affect the present for Founders/Standard owners?[/B]
No - everything is the same, as it was before the announcement.

[B]Q4 - Are there any differences going into the future for Founders/Standar owners?[/B]
Everything is the same except that Loot Crates are announced for the Store.  These can be PAID or PLAYED for.

[B]Q5 - Do you need a Key to unlock said Loot Crates?[/B]
Gross, absolutely not.

[B]Q7 - If I have Founder Access, is it worth it to upgrade to Elite?[/B]
To be honest, probably not for most and it was designed this way.  The only major differences between Elite and Founder are the exclusive cosmetic items, 10 games worth of Ion equalling $1 and the biggest addition which is the confirmation/inclusion of the first 20 Guardians.  That last part may be the only part that would be worth it to YOU the player.  However this is also an option for people that do love exclusive items or simply want to support us in that way.

[B]Q8 - Will the Elite program ever go away?[/B]
It is scheduled to be around permanently.

[B]Q9 - When will the Elite program begin?[/B]
No official date just yet, working on getting Version 1.5 out to the public and we will have more details.

[B]Q10 - Founders can upgrade for $50 instead of $100?[/B]
Yes that is correct.

[B]Q11 - Is there a limit to how long Founders can do the $50 upgrade?[/B]
It is scheduled to be permanent.

[B]Q12 - If I upgrade to Elite and get unlocks instead of purchases, what happens to my already-achieved Levels per Guardian?[/B]
Originally there was no retro-active reward.  But we will find a way to honor already-completed levels using the announced model (Bronze/Silver/Gold crate distribution).

[B]Q13 - Will the 20 Guardians towards Elite be available to other owners (Standard/Founders)?[/B]
Absolutely - they will use the same Store.

[B]Q14 - If I am a Founder with 50% Savings already and upgrade to Elite with that 50% stack for 100% Savings?[/B]
Of course not.

[B]Q15 - Is the Elite Pet faster or better in any way?[/B]
No it just looks different, cosmetic only.  No Pay-2-Win!
[/quote]

The Orion Project
$1 or $100
Play Your Way
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

notes.title: Version 1.6 - Changing Things Up (Guardians)
notes.content:
Version 1.6 - Changing Things Up
We recently re-designed how Guardian Purchases will work going forward, likely starting with Version 1.6. I want to split up the cost of the Guardians as they currently stand, and to do this the best way is to split the gameplay from the visual:

1. We are going to sell new Guardians (aka Playstyles) for $5. This includes the Ability, Weapon Loadout, Voice and more. 

2. Then we are going to sell the Armor pieces separately for the other $5, which would include the Helmet, Arms, Legs and Chest.

So it's still all the same content and this will allow us to add tons of armor to the store for users to enjoy at a much faster rate without having to hold it back to wait for Guardian/programming integration. It also allows more affordable prices across each and allows users to get exactly what they want.

notes.title: (Galactic Council) Rules & Guidelines
notes.content:
I will start by saying that we absolutely love what we do.  We love being creative, we love making games, we love working in and with Orion and we enjoy all of you who devote so much time to playing and making this a special place.

Most fortunately, unlike most developers, we aren't in it for the money.  This permits us the freedom to cultivate an incredible community which we are regularly and constantly complimented on.

I understand that the toxic people we remove or uninvite don't enjoy this, but it makes the universe much better overall.

We work hard and don't have the luxury of time, nor would we ever choose to put up with certain types of toxic community members. This results in updates coming out extremely fast.

It's a controversial development style, but it works for us and makes the experience much more enjoyable when surrounded by good people.

That being said, every knife in the box isn't always as sharp as the others and we want to ensure that users are aware of our mentality now and going forward:

[quote]
[h1]Forum Rules[/h1]
1. By participating in these forums, you agree to the Guidelines and Rules below, as well as the Terms of Use and Code of Conduct. 
 
2. You shall not harass, defraud, threaten or cause distress and/or unwanted attention to other members or staff. This includes name-calling, trying to provoke other users, flaming users, or singling out a user’s actions. 
 
3. We actively encourage feedback and opinions in our forums. However, ‘rants’ or ‘bashing’ posts are prohibited and will result in moderation action. 
 
4. The decisions and actions of our forum moderation team are final. Discussing moderation decisions and/or private communications made by members of our forum moderation team publicly in any way will result in further moderation action being taken. 
 
5. Profanity, slurs, and otherwise obscene language is prohibited in our community. This includes any misspellings, substituting punctuation, or any other methods that reflect an otherwise banned word. 
 
6. You shall not impersonate any employees of Trek Industries or its partners, past or present. This includes members of the Community Moderation Team and other forum members. 
 
7. Petitions of any kind are not permitted – this includes linking to and discussing petitions. We welcome the feedback of our players, but in the discussion-based manner our forum thrives with. Please note that polls with multiple options and sensibly constructed voting options are permitted. 
 
8. Posting of unofficial information is not permitted on the forums – we will remove any content of this nature regardless of its validity. Consistently breaking this rule will result in moderation action. 
 
9. No spamming. Empty posts, off-topic replies, or spam posts will be deleted. Posts that significantly detract from the forums will not be tolerated. 
 
10. No flaming or trolling. Personal attacks to other members, mods, admins, or employees will be deleted and may result in a ban. Posts meant to incite others or post derogatory information about others are strictly forbidden. 
 
11. No pornographic material, illegal software, cheating, hacking, illegal content, trademarked/copyrighted content that does not belong to you, racist, sexist or offensive content, or links to any of those materials. Do not promote or endorse any illegal or offensive activities. Any discussion or linking to topics that violates the Terms of Use or Code of Conduct is prohibited. This rule is strictly enforced and will result in a ban. 
 
12. Do not abuse the use of signatures. Any signatures that are an eyesore will be edited and/or deleted. 
 
13. Do not post the same thread more than once, or in different forum categories. 
 
14. Off-topic threads or threads that go off-topic may locked. 
 
15. Do not knowingly post misinformation, lies, or false facts. Additionally, please use official sources whenever possible when speaking in definitive terms. 
 
16. No solicitation or reward-based advertising. 
 
17. No trading of codes, merchandise, services, or any other tradable item. Giveaways must be approved by a member of the Trek community team. 
 
18. Do not post your or anyone else’s personal, sensitive, or confidential information on these forums. If any user asks you for personal information, do not provide it. 
 
19. One forum account per user/person only. Banned or suspended users may not make new accounts to join. No exceptions. 
 
20. Our board only supports English language posts at this time. Any posts in other languages will be removed. 
 
21. Posting child sexual abuse content of any kind will not be tolerated. Any serious content considered to imply or hint towards child sexual abuse will be reported to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) immediately (within 24 hours), and all posts will be deleted. 
 
22. This forum and all content on these forums are the property of Trek Industries, Inc. 
 
Any violation of the rules above or any actions that create a negative experience for others may result in a temporary or permanent ban of your account. By posting on these forums, you agree to abide by these rules. 
 
Forum Content and Responsibility 
You remain solely responsible for the content of your messages on these forums as well as your actions on these forums. By participating on these forums, you assume responsibility for your actions. 
[/quote]

To sum it all up:

[h1]( 1-  Don't Be A ♥♥♥♥ )[/h1]
• Don't be rude to other users.  
• Refrain from aggressive swearing.  
• No racism.  
• No Filthy User names.
• Condescending remarks and belittlement won't last long.

[h1] ( 2 - Don't Be Stupid ) [/h1]
• Research previously posted topics/threads before posting a duplicate.
• Ask questions first, make any demands later.

[h1] ( 3 - Don't Hack/Cheat ) [/h1]
• Any manipulation of game or server files will result in any or all of the following:
Game Ban, Community Ban, Credit/Ion Depletion, Character Resets, Inventory Wipes.

[h1]( 4 - Be Constructive + Productive )[/h1]
• Provide specific feedback so it can better assist Devs and Consumers.  
• If you have issues with optimization, provide your hardware and software setup. 

[h1]( Two Basic Principles )[/h1]
It all boils down to two basic principles:
1. Treat others as how you would like to be treated.
2. Early bird gets the worm.

If you're a ♥♥♥♥, you will be treated like one.
If you're an idiot, you will be treated like one.
If you're a troll, you will be trolled.
If you cheat, we will waste your time.

If you're supportive, we will support you.
If you're appreciative, we will appreciate you.
If you contribute, we will meet you halfway.
If you supply feedback, we will listen.
If you have a question, we will respond.

Anything not following guidelines is subject to locking, deleting or bans/removals, especially with consecutive occurrences.

notes.title: Elite Package, Loot Crates, Loot Levels, V1.5 Release
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WEQj5c9.png[/img]
We are rapidly approaching the release of Version 1.5 and are just putting as many final touches in place before we let you all in and enjoy.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRTnpp5ufD4

[h1]( VERSION 1.5 - FPS MODULE 1.0 )[/h1]
First public release of v1.5.0 is expected to debut TOMORROW, Saturday - June 4, 2016.  We will follow up with a v1.5.1 to add/adjust a few things that are known but also integrating any community-posted feedback.

This is the biggest update yet adding the much demanded FPS portion of the game.  While already even more in-depth and amazing than what we did with Prelude we've already announced/confirmed/committed to more!  We will be doing an FPS Module 2.0 follow up in 2017 and further the content by adding Weapon Sights (ADS) and Weapon Attachments/Customization.
 

[h1]( ELITE PACKAGE )[/h1]
We are scheduled to offer a new version of The Orion Project which will be the Elite Package.  This will retail for $100 towards new owners and only a $50 upgrade option available for Founders if they wish to do so as it is NOT required. 
[quote]
[b]Elite Package Details[/b]
· Armors/Hats/Helmets/Skins as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS
· 50% Store Savings*
· 10,000,000 Starting Ion
· Access to the first 20 Guardians
· Exclusive Elite Armor
· Exclusive Elite Helmet
· Exclusive Elite Cloak
· Exclusive Pet
· Exclusive Game Icon
[/quote]
[i]* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners.  All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount.

*The Elite Package is expected to launch Summer 2016.[/i]


[h1]( LOOT CRATES & LOOT LEVELS )[/h1]
Loot Crates are coming to both versions of the game, Standard & Elite.  For the Standard version of the game all three versions of the Loot Crate will be available at the Trek Store for the following prices:
· Bronze Crate: $1
· Silver Crate: $5

notes.title: Version 1.6 - First Details!
notes.content:
We are gearing up to release Version 1.5 in the next couple of days/week and are very excited to share what we've been working on with you.

We have had the Pre-Production and Production teams working on Version 1.6 and 1.7 while the Integration team finished off 1.5.  We have just settled on the main focus areas for 1.6 and they are listed below:

[h1] MECHS! [/h1]
We are going to launch with three classes and a unit per each.  This is in addition to a unique set of weaponry created just for the mechs.

[h1] PvP! [/h1]
We are going to launch Version 1.6 with three PvP game modes!

[b]( MAYHEM ) (40 Players) (Free-For-All)[/b]
[list]
[*] This is one of the largest PvP mode offerings for the immediate future.  
[*] This will use specialized NEW maps like The Cove + The Island.
[*] This allows for ALL Guardians to be used and will be a great way to see ability VS ability.
[/list]

[b]( HARVESTER HUNT ) (4v4, Team Elimination)[/b]
[list]
[*] This pits two teams against one another, each tasked with having to protect their Harvester unit from the enemy team AND wild life, all while trying to eliminate the opposing teams unit.
[*] This will use existing maps such as Relic, Haven, Strike and more.
[/list]

[b]( MECH WARS ) (4v4, Team Objective)[/b]
[list]
[*] This will feature all the new mechs and mech content and pay homage to other games like Mech Assault and Titan Fall.
[*] This will use existing maps such as Relic, Haven, Strike and more.
[/list]

notes.title: Let's Have A Chat
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WEQj5c9.png[/img]

There has been some confusion regarding what we're up to and I wanted to clear a few things up for everyone.

A little while ago we cancelled all other titles/developments at Trek Industries once we internally committed to approaching The Orion Project again.  While most of these titles and games were never publicly announced or mentioned, some were. 

These cancellations included games like:
1. ORION: Interlude (sequel to Prelude)
2. ORION: Interlude (Episodic Campaign)
3. ORION: Retro (action/platformer)
4. ORION: Fueled (Adrenaline Racing)
5. ORION 1 (Campaign, Trilogy)
6. ORION 2 (Campaign, Trilogy)
7. ORION 3 (Campaign, Trilogy)
8. OrionVR


[h1]( WHY WE CANCELLED THEM )[/h1]
We decided to cancel these titles not because we're not going to be delivering these experiences, but because we want to deliver them in a new and unique way - a way that doesn't split or segregate the community by forcing an annual or bi-annual re-purchase of a new game or sequel.  This also benefits us on the development side of things allowing us to focus on what we create instead of going backwards and re-creating/re-modulating systems and modules every year.


[h1]( WHAT WE ARE DOING INSTEAD )[/h1]
Instead we're going to use all those designs and technology and integrate it into one giant and connected experience via The Orion Project.  These are games within games, but are being called Modules because of their inner-connected relationships/parallel activity alongside other modules at the same time.


[h1]( ORION: PRELUDE 2 = FPS MODULE 1.0/2.0 )[/h1]
So you'll be getting that sequel to Prelude, which is incredible FPS and Third-Person gameplay with the ability to purchase Weapons/Vehicles (coming after 1.5) and tackling side objectives and bonus missions.  It won't just be a new camera angle and weapons as we've also evolved the overall gameplay that occurs during these modules and perspectives and will be taking it a step further.  


[h1]( THE EVOLUTION )[/h1]
You can see these in changes like the mobility of the power source (Harvester) compared to the Power Gen (Prelude), the ability to buy weapons/vehicles anywhere rather than running all the way to a shop, the confirmation of weapon attachments, the deeper player customization and so much more.  

So if you're a fan coming from ORION: Prelude you will find the experience of the sequel within The Orion Project courtesy of the FPS Module 1.0 and 2.0, otherwise previously known as and using content/assets/designs from ORION Interlude (aka ORION: Prelude 2).


[h1]( ENTIRE GAMES WORTH OF CONTENT )[/h1]
You're getting an entire FPS games worth of content courtesy of this integration.  We will be doing the same thing with the Mechs and we will be doing a full games worth instead of a Mech-spin off game.  

So instead of just one Mech vehicle with a preset weapon loadout in the game like Prelude, we will have multiple classes of Mechs with an on-going and growing list of unit types within those classes.  In addition we are developing an entire arsenal of weapons exclusively for the Mechs and the content of the Mech module will be comparable to a game like Titan Fall 1.

The same goes for the Racing module(s), the Campaign, and so on and so forth.

- - -

We are tackling each project one at a time to not get overwhelmed and I believe we are making incredible progress and a year from now people will very much enjoy what we are all building together.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

notes.title: ORION: Prelude 2 - Coming June 2016
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/E0aymvV.png[/img]

[h1] ( PRELUDE FANS REJOICE! )[/h1]
We are going to work our butts off in order to deliver you all (and us) one hell of a game!  The direct sequel to our first indie mega hit, ORION: Prelude is coming June 2016 courtesy of The Orion Project!
https://youtu.be/v6Nddfw2NnQ

[h1]( THE ORION PROJECT )[/h1]
The ultimate Space Adventure and Combat Video Game for PC. The Orion Project is a living, breathing and Persistent Universe allowing for you to travel the Galaxy and experience Open World Gameplay like never before!

[h1]( NO PAY WALLS - EVER)[/h1]
There will never be a pay wall between any two friends.  Even for specific/exclusive content like the 2017 Campaign, if one friend owns it he or she can invite any non-owning friends to participate, for example.

[h1]( MANY GAMES IN ONE )[/h1]
The Orion Project is one of the largest video game projects ever undertaken.  It will ultimately be a culmination of many games pieced together as one giant one.  

I want to make Racing games, Fighting games, Social games, Sims, Building Games and more.  But instead of making 20 or so titles over the course of 5-10 years and charging you anywhere from $10-$60 for the, I'd rather focus all those experiences into "The Orion Project" in interesting and creative ways.

[h1]( ORION PRELUDE 2 / ORION: INTERLUDE )[/h1]
Many people ask what happened to these games and if they still exist.  This title of course still exists and is coming to The Orion Project under the name of "FPS Module".  

[h1]( PAY OR PLAY )[/h1]
If we sell anything inside of The Orion Project for a real-world currency it is our objective to also make it obtainable via Store Credits all the same.

[h1]( EARNING CREDITS )[/h1]
There are already a variety of ways to earn Store Credits in the game, including: Daily + Weekly Quests, Trek Achievements as well as an upcoming ION-to-CREDIT conversion system.

[h1]( THE CAMPAIGN )[/h1]
"ORION 1" is coming courtesy of the newly announced Campaign Module starting in 2017.  Get ready for some epic cooperative/single-player missions and story!

The Orion Project is only $1 on Steam
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840

notes.title: Annual Campaign - Starting 2017*
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SjNrg3w.jpg[/img]

We have many things planned for The Orion Project, including a Cooperative Campaign scheduled to begin in 2017.  

[h1]( CAMPAIGNS & MISSSIONS )[/h1]
This is will feature Premium content and allow Players to purchase/obtain Missions that take them to unique places in the Galaxy while exploring more of the Lore.


[h1]( THE FIRST CAMPAIGN - MURDOCKE )[/h1]
The first Campaign is scheduled to focus on Murdocke Enterprises as well as it's Founder and Director, Richard Murdocke.  You will explore many Murdocke-associated areas and explore their dark secrets and hidden agendas.  The first Campaign is schedule to feature 5 Missions while future Campaigns are targeting 10.


[h1]( ABOUT MURDOCKE ENTERPRISES )[/h1]
Richard Murdocke owns Nova City.  Nova City was primarily a human trafficking and slavery cargo operation by Murdocke Enterprises. They set this up to get mass cargo out to the new Solar System and had been mining Rigel for a century before anyone else got there.

This first began in the 1940's unknown to any government, corporation or faction. After many uprisings it finally succumbed to a criminal or exiled hideout for many and was only later discovered upon the mass arrival of the Guardians and Crew in the period of which this game takes place.

Nova City is the dirty and "evil" city akin to a Coruscant mixed with a Gotham. There will be crowds of unique species, unique vendors and you'll be able to travel and interact here with many other Guardians at once.


[h1]( DISCLAIMERS & NOTES )[/h1]
*We will never feature Pay Walls between friends.  If one friend owns the Campaign/Mission they can invite non-owning friends to their session.  

*Each Campaign is expected to be multiple missions and we are aiming to do a new and unique campaign annually.  

*Each Campaign will pay homage to a different genre/theme and the Murdocke Campaign will be Horror-inspired.  This will pay homage to DOOM, ALIEN and many more of our favorites!

*This is separate from Raids and Strikes.


[h1]( FIRST LOOK )[/h1]
Murdocke Enterprises conducted a variety of experiments in underground facilities on both human and alien species.  You will encounter many of these, including the Beserker which is teased in a detailing image below:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fwjtsn2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nova City - Reveal Teaser
notes.content:
[h1]VERSION 1.7 WILL BE EPIC![/h1]
We have just started Pre-Production on Version 1.6 and Version 1.7. We are especially excited for 1.7 because it will be the first time we are able to introduce new creatures and species from within the Orion universe.
https://youtu.be/ezaMaVpWZWI

We are adding many Social/RPG modules including the Exploration Module. This is scheduled to allow you to explore three massive locations at launch, including Nova City, The Cove and Enclave. There are unique characters in each location and you'll be able to interact with them to Buy, Shop and Trade!

[quote]
[h1]MORTY FLINT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 8 Feet, 6 Inches
[*] Weight: 1,250 Pounds
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dsBiJsv.jpg[/img]
Here is the first sketch of Morty Flint, a Rekan species from the Rock World of Okra. Many of the Rekan species were bred as warriors due to their nearly indestructible skin.

Now retired from war, Morty can be found in the Mining Colony of Nova City where he sells Weapons & Gear for a price.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]RUNO OSO[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 4 Feet, 2 Inches
[*] Weight: 125 Pounds
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wyKDW1E.jpg[/img]
Here is the first sketch of Runo Oso, a Geema species from the Wetlands World of Sangshin. Due to their proximity to the mining world of Nova City they had immense access to broken or lost technology and salvage courtesy of the cargo runs near orbit.

This allowed constant exposure to technology and devices allowing the Geemans to interact with it for extended generations making them some of the best engineers in the New Solar System.

Runo Oso now occupies Nova City and can be found selling Personal Drones in the back alleys.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]DOVION "THE DEALER"[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 6 Feet, 2 Inches

notes.title: All This Development For Only $1?? (Explained)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/jCEiXXx.png[/img]

My most asked question is: [b]"HOW DO YOU DO ALL THIS FOR A GAME THAT IS ONLY $1?"[/b]

Someone recently put an accurate term towards what we are doing, and that is Loss Leader Marketing.

[quote]
[h1]WHAT IS LOSS LEADER MARKETING?[/h1]
It is a pricing strategy where a product is sold at a price below its market cost to stimulate other sales of more profitable goods or services located within. With this sales promotion—marketing strategy, a "leader" is used as a related term and can mean any popular article, i.e., an object sold at a normal price.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]OUR FIRT TEST - APPROACHING 3 MILLION COPIES[/h1]
We tested a more shallow model of this system with our first game, ORION: Prelude and it ended up selling what is about to hit 3 million copies this year.  That is an insane number no matter what price of the game or what size of the developer, indie or AAA.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/

It was a system that worked, many people enjoyed it and were surprised/impressed wiith it and we are now doing our real version of the model which will be all that more rewarding for players AND developers alike.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ShQ3GBFI4KQ
[/quote]
[quote]
[h1]THE PRICETAG IS THE CHEAPEST PART[/h1]
So while it only costs $1 to have an incredible experience and hundreds of hours of gameplay as many current users already have proven, it is by far the cheapest payment in the game.  But that is the thing, you don't need to pay to really have a full experience.  

You'll get all that gameplay, you'll have access to the modes, the pvp, the systems/inventories and whatever you want more of you simply PLAY or PAY (once we add ion-to-credit conversion) for those things.  There won't be any pay walls between friends and you'll see a system that really works once in place.
[/quote]
[quote]
[h1]BUILDING EXACTLY WHAT YOU WANT[/h1]
And we are going to have a great deal of those things and we know exactly what you want which is what makes us so fast and so very dangerous.  We not only have what I hope are moderately good tastes, but we scour our communities and fans for feedback and have done so for years and know exactly the game not only fans of Orion want, but fans of video games in general.
[/quote]

[h1]ACCESS FOR ALL[/h1]
By selling it for $1 we allow that dream to happen and get to include all types of gamers no matter what is in their wallet.  They not only feel included and supported in that way but the minute they opt in to play The Orion Project and see how we treat them through our product and direct relationships it's a no brainer at what we can all achieve together with this game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

notes.title: Galactic Council Module (2017) - Register Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0yhbAbQ.png[/img]

[i]We are announcing the [b]Galactic Council Module[/b] quite a early (won't be coming for a year or so) but it's in order to begin receiving as much information and as many applicants as possible.  If you want to become even more involved with development and or the community, this news is for YOU![/i]

The [b]Galactic Council (/Order of Ion) Module[/b] is a future module coming to The Orion Project that begins to involve the community in new and incredible ways.  We're very big on developing this game right aside you and want to illustrate this starting here.

This will be an annual event and the first election will be in 2017.  It will be an voting-based election and allow for 10 community members to become elected and have a seat at the Galactic Council.  This will coincide with the other 10 seats primarily made up of Developers known as the "Order of Ion" and will be the acting arm for the word of the Galactic Council.

[quote]
[h1]( HOW TO REGISTER ) [/h1]
To become eligible for a Galactic Council seat you must prepare a presentation (written or recorded) and submit it to council@trek-industries.com by January 1, 2017.  In this presentation you must cover seven topics:

1. Why are you interested?
2. What would make you/your perspective unique?
3. What is(are) your current favorite game(s)?
4. What is(are) your favorite game(s) of all time?
5. What is your Age?
6. What is your Gender?
7. Do you have any past experience in serving/representation in real life or another game community (admin, moderator, etc).
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]( GALACTIC COUNCIL PERKS )[/h1]
As a Galactic Council member you will receive a plethora of exclusive perks, including:
[list]
[*] Annual Seat @ Galactic Council
[*] Access to Council Cloak
[*] Access to Council Ion Blade
[*] Access to Council Armor Set
[*] Access to Council Pet
[*] Access to Council game icon
[*] Access to ION Council Multi-Person Starship
[*] Access to monthly ION Meetings
[*] Access to WIP Developer Builds
[*] Access to exclusive Galactic areas including Shrines and Temples
[*] Galactic protection by the Ion Drone Army
[/list]
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1] ( GALACTIC COUNCIL RESPONSIBILITIES )[/h1]
Council Members will be involved in major decisions, including but not limited 
[list]
[*] Toxic Player Behavior & Remediation
[*] Banning/Jailing/Fining
[*] Aiding in Player Disputes
[*] Access to Exclusive Missions from James Trek
[*] Lore/Archive Buildup (finding Data Logs as a Council Member makes them available for other players to read/discover in Library/Archive areas of future modules).
[*] + more!
[/quote]

This is just a very early announcement.  If anyone is interested in this module please apply and look forward to meeting you soon!

notes.title: Your Feedback - The Results!
notes.content:
We started a poll yesterday trying to obtain as much feedback as possible about your experiences with The Orion Project.  We asked you to answer three questions:
[code]
1 - What do you currently love the most? 
2 - What do you currently dislike the most? 
3 - What feature/module/component are you looking forward to the most? 
[/code]

[h1]( WHAT YOU LOVE )[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gameplay
[*] Camera Switching
[*] Skills/Gear Systems
[*] Music
[*] Augments
[*] Class Variety
[*] Dinosaurs
[*] Loot
[*] Visuals
[*] RPG Elements
[/list]

[h1]( WHAT YOU DISLIKE )[/h1]
[list]
[*] Current User Interface
[*] Current 3rd Person Animations
[*] Performance/Optimization
[*] HUD Vanishing Bug
[*] Harv in Survival (devnotes: swapping to a stationary Power Core)
[*] Current Party/Friend Invite/Join system
[*] Loading Screens
[*] Server Performance (f2p week)
[/list]

[h1]( WHAT YOU WANT THE MOST )[/h1]
[list]
[*] First Person Module***
[*] Open Galaxy Module
[*] Open World Module
[*] The Island Module (40-Player, FFA PvP)
[*] Guardian Creation Module
[*] New 3rd Person Action Camera
[*] Raids/Strike Module (10 Player Co-Op Missions)
[*] The Citadel Module (Player Housing)
[*] The Dungeon Module (Hardcore PvE, Robots, Rare Items)
[*] New Maps, Enemies & Bosses 
[*] Vehicles + Mech Module
[*] Social Modules (Nova City, NPC's, Vendors, Trading, Markets)
[*] Ability to purchase the OST
[*] More Modes
[*] Weapon Loadout Variety for each Guardian
[*] New Guardians
[*] Quests
[*] Updated AI, mostly for Vertical/On-Rock Players
[*] Improved Crafting System+Tutorial
[*] More Side Objectives (Harvest)
[*] Clan System
[*] More Voice Commands/Additional Personality
VoIP/Voice Chat
[*] Pets/Loot Collectors
[*] Account Name Changes
[*] Tutorial
[*] Base Building Modules
[*] In-Game Voting System (Kicks, Maps, Pops, etc)
[*] Post Game Vote System (Voting on next match or allowing a "return to orbit")
[/list]


[h1]SOME DEV COMMENTS[/h1]
[code]
We will be allowing Guardians to swap to different weapons in matches via SkyFly shopping.  Think of it like CS:GO buying.

We will also have a Character Creation system in the game allowing you to make your own Character with things like Armor, Ability, Weapon loadouts and more.

Offline play will be supported with new content/modules, but online is the primary focus and once that is built up it'll carry over and be worked towards a great single player experience.

Yes the DropPod spawn sequence is planned to be pilot-able in the second half.  The flaps will open a bit higher up and that is when the Player will assume control to specify which area they want to land in.

notes.content:

[*] Dinosaurs

VoIP/Voice Chat

notes.content:
This is the first community challenge for The Orion Project where developers and community can help each other for the possibility of epic rewards!

Let's see if we can do one million copies during this event.  If we succeed in this we will be able to:

2. Able to setup the first physical studio.
3. Hire additional talent.

( THE REWARDS )
All of that allows for faster production which in the end benefits you!  But that's not enough.  If we succeed then I want to do the same in return and we will offer ALL of you the following perks:
•100,000 Store Credits ($100 value)
•100,000,000 ION (Roughly 100-200 Survival games worth, depending on gear and difficulty)

So tell your friends, tell your family or tell your lovers.  Post it on Facebook, forums, comments, chats and anywhere else you can without getting in trouble.

Make this happen and It's guarantee we will deliver a game that will be what you've always wanted.

We will post the results of this week's event win or lose and we wish you good luck and hope to see you in game!

notes.title: Welcome To The Orion Project!
notes.content:
We have some BIG news to share!  We have recently completely expanded our intentions for this title and renamed it to The Orion Project to reflect this.  

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840


[h1] ( THE UNIVERSE EXPANDED ) [/h1]
We have a 5+ year development schedule in place for The Orion Project and will be regularly updating the game with brand new features and content while retaining what everyone already loves.  We will be beginning with new modules such as: First-Person, PvP, Cities with Vendors and NPCs, Mechs and Open Galaxy Gameplay.



[h1] ( ABOUT THE ORION PROJECT ) [/h1]
The Orion Project will be only $1 and will become the ultimate video game for PC with gameplay consisting of four main modules, including: Social, Exploration, Adventure and Combat. 

https://youtu.be/-0W3cwwMqwE

The Orion Project is a living, breathing and Persistent Universe allowing for you to travel the Galaxy and experience Open World Gameplay like never before! Explore vast Regions each with unique Wildlife and Weather patterns, to Harvest and collect resources, Loot Gear and Level up your Characters while fighting through a variety of Objectives, Missions and Quests. 

https://youtu.be/TtmRUGtyXX0
Take to the skies and visit neighboring Planets and Moons using your Guardian Starship. Arrive at Orbital Command or Nova City, a Social Hub for a large number of players to Interact, Trade, Meet or Shop at or take a moment to relax at your new Residence located at The Citadel. 

[h1]Welcome to the Galaxy - Endless possibilities await[/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840

notes.title: I Am Coming For You, Star Citizen (Part 1/2)
notes.content:
We don't need $100 million.
We don't need 500 developers.
We don't need multiple studios.
https://youtu.be/cKmdo0y2his

Star Citizen has been affecting many gamers.  Most importantly it has begun threatening platforms/models I believe in and that genuine (indie) developers can truly make use of.  For every action there is an opposite and equal reaction and I am going to be that reaction right now. 
http://www.gamespot.com/articles/star-citizen-creator-wishes-hed-explained-games-de/1100-6434856/

With that much money, that much talent and that much time there sure is very little for their consumers to actually play.  With recent developments/comments on their end and seeing how they interact/look at/treat their fans I've felt the need to tackle this straight on.
https://goo.gl/BFLQDQ

- - - - - 
Guardians of Orion on Steam
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840

Music by Sugar Monroe (Neon Life)
- - - - - 
We can deliver that experience for far less.  We will illustrate this via Guardians of Orion.  FPS confirmed, Orbital Command confirmed, Orbital FPS PvP confirmed, etc, etc.  Oh and this will all be available for $1 starting May 2016.  

Star Marine has missed many dates.  From what I can recall it now no longer has a date.  That is a shame but one that I am going to fix.  Our new mode will satiate anyone's hunger for Orbital FPS. The name for this mode is appropriately titled Star Guardian.  More details coming as we approach the March/April/May releases.

The fun stuff is coming by Summer 2016.
I am coming for you, Star Citizen.  

Love, 
David

notes.title: First-Person (And Vehicles) Are Coming (Technically Speaking)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1n1I7ad.jpg[/img]

We're pleased to announce that the Steam Lunar Event for Guardians of Orion has achieved exactly what we strived for, and that was game awareness.  The sales had increased exponentially, with the very first 12 hours of the event having sold more copies of the game compared to the first two months of sale.

As a result I am happy to announce that we are growing our Commitment List for Guardians of Orion with two new/added features:

1. Vehicular Combat (Spring 2016)
We hope to add many vehicles to the game, but for now we're committed to two.  The TREK Hoverboard which will aid players in navigating the worlds at an increased rate, and look cool while doing so.  The other vehicle is the Trek Tiger Mech which is equipped with a gatling turret and side mounted rockets.  Both vehicles should prove worthy in turning the tide of any battle.  We are expecting to begin vehicle inclusion as soon as Spring 2016.

2. Orbital Command (FPS) (Spring 2016)
We are going to be redoing the menu a bit in the upcoming future.  Once you load the game you'll have two options, including CONNECT (Online Gameplay) and OFFLINE (Solo Gameplay).  If you choose to CONNECT you'll be taking to an Orbital Command Center where you and (aiming for) up to 40 players can gather, socialize, manage inventories, look at available missions, check daily/weekly/monthly quests+rewards, purchase store/cosmetic items and more:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SO9CNnm.jpg[/img]  
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Fzhn4Uo.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HZEHXsf.jpg[/img]

This will be a very small prototype and only the surface of what we believe we can achieve with these systems.  We hope to grow them and we have another Steam event in the near future.  We appreciate your support and with it we can do some pretty amazing things.  Hope you're enjoying Guardians of Orion!

Guardians of Orion on Steam
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

ORION: Prelude on Steam
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/

notes.title: Guardians of Orion - $1 Starting May 2016
notes.content:
I wanted to give an in-depth update regarding our recently adjusted Guardians of Orion production forecast.  

https://youtu.be/XY1etHdeTqc

Suffice to say, the game did far less than we expected and we have to adjust our intentions for it respectively.  To paint a quick picture, I've included some statistics below:

[code]
[B](LAUNCH DAY - COPIES SOLD)[/B]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown: 10,141 Copies (May 4, 2012)[/*]
[*]Guardians of Orion: 694 Copies (Dec 1, 2015)[/*]
[/list]

[B](WEEK 1 - COPIES SOLD)[/B]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown: 39,950 Copies (May 4, 2012 - May 11, 2012)[/*]
[*]Guardians of Orion: 3,800 Copies (Dec 1, 2015 - Dec 8, 2015)[/*]
[/list]

[B](MONTH 1 - COPIES SOLD)[/B]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown: 47,025 Copies (May 2012)[/*]
[*]Guardians of Orion: 5,694 Copies (Dec 2015)[/*]
[/list]

[B](DAY SALES - 2 MONTHS LATER(+/-)[/B]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown: 110 Copies (Jun 30, 2012)[/*]
[*]Guardians of Orion: 3 Copies (Jan 28, 2015)[/*]
[/list]
[/code]

[B]SOME QUICK NOTES:[/B]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown had the least # of fans leading up to it.[/*]
[*]ORION: Dino Horde had 50,000+ fans going into it (Dino Beatdown).[/*]
[*]ORION: Prelude had 500,000 fans going into it (Dino Horde).[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown sold 50,000 copies.[/*]
[*]ORION: Dino Horde sold 500,000 copies.[/*]
[*]ORION: Prelude sold 1,500,000+ copies[/*]
[*]Guardians of Orion has sold less than 7,000 copies.[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]ORION: Dino Beatdown had an average rating of 30%[/*]
[*]ORION: Prelude had an average rating of 70-80%[/*]
[*]Guardians of Orion has an average rating of roughly 90%[/*]
[/list]

[B]@THE BREAKDOWN[/B]
1. Guardians of Orion has the most established fan base going into it (2,000,000+ fans)
2. Guardians of Orion had the largest budget.
3. Guardians of Orion had the smoothest release, especially for Early Access.
4. All owners of Guardians of Orion are very happy/satisfied with their purchases.
5. Guardians of Orion typically averages a 9/10 (compared to a 3/10 with Dino Beatdown)
6. Guardians of Orion had the MOST demand for Press out of any of our titles (with little to show???)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CWgZiEv.jpg[/img]

A mega thank you goes out to RPGMinx for continually supporting us and a big thanks to BestInSlot for the early support):
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AcffYeA.png[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/TheRPGMinx]TheRPGMinx @ YouTube[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/ForAdventure]BestInSlot @ YouTube[/url]

[B]@PROJECTIONS[/B]
Guardians of Orion simply isn't selling.  We had forecasted initial projections/promises based on our (then) lowest selling products, including the Source Prototype and Dino Beatdown to use as figure-heads.  However Guardians of Orion is doing significantly worse than those projections and it just isn't feasible to continue supporting it as we had hoped.  

[B]@2012 ERA[/B]
In comparison, ORION: Dino Beatdown had at least obtained a budget that allowed us to forecast/project a product for over a years worth of time, just in the first month of sales.  There was obvious support and a desire to see a game like this and it was a very easy decision, despite the backlashing.  We knew we'd be able to deliver the product we wanted in the afforded time frame. 

[B]@MIGRATION[/B]
Guardians of Orion hasn't been supported since Day 1, including it's crowdfunding Campaign on Kickstarter ([url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion/posts/1395367]that we still honored[/url]) and it's become very apparent on what you all want and don't want.  I cannot safely do the same method with Guardians of Orion as Dino Beatdown/Prelude due to being a smaller company and needing to focus on what works and keeps all of those involved afloat and supported.  So instead of supporting a product that is dangerous for us to build up, and one that seemingly few people want, we're going to be moving on to our next project sooner than later.

[B]@UPCOMING CONTENT[/B]
Before we do that I want to get Guardians of Orion to a certain state, content wise.  Because of this we are re-focusing our efforts on Guardians over the next few months before officially migrating to the new FPS and we are going to focus on features that add longevity and community-focus to the game.  Here is an overview of what we are scheduled to add to the game before wrapping production:
[list]
[*]SDK/Workshop Support
[*]Voice Chat Support
[*]Voting System
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]4-Player Local Co-Op
[*]SkyFly Real-Time Shopping
[*]My Guardian Creation
[*]4 New Multiplayer Maps
[*]6 New Guardians (FREE for Founders)
[*]Revamped Slaughter Mode
[*]Gear/Loot/Inventory/Crafting
[*]Trek Store (Hats, Guardians, Skins)
[*]Additional Server Support (Europe, Asia)
[/list]

What's definitely NOT coming includes Vehicles and Strike Missions, which were related/tied together.

[B]@FOUNDERS[/B]
As always, we are going to take care of the people who do come out to support us.  We wouldn't be here without you and we wouldn't be doing what we do.  We have a great Founder Program scheduled for Guardians of Orion and I've detailed it below:
[code]
[B]Q: How to become a Founder?[/B]
A: Purchase the game before May 1, 2016.  Make sure to login to the game servers, otherwise it won't count as we use our back end to tie it all together. After May 1, 2016 the game will be reduced to $1 for NEW BUYERS (AKA Non-Founders).

[B]Q: What do Founders receive?[/B]
A:  A full list below:
[list]
[*]All 10 Guardians
[*]20,000 Store Credits
[*]Founder Icon 
[*]Gold Armor Skin
[*]Gold Weapon Skin
[/list]

[B]Q: What do Non-Founders get?[/B]
A: Everything in the base game except they only start with the 3 Starting Guardians (Assault, Support, Recon).  The rest will require a premium purchase via the Trek Store (in-game) and will be $9.99/each.

[B]Q: Best time to become a Founder?[/B]
A: There is an upcoming Steam Event will Guardians will be marked down significantly for one last opportunity to become a Founder.  Don't say we didn't warn you - now is the time to save!

[B]Q: When do you expect to wrap up development on Guardians?[/B]
A: With all developers/content producers back on the re-focused Guardians we are scheduled to finish in Q2 2016.  

[B]Q: Are you willing to continue supporting GOO if it does well later on?[/B]
A: Very possible but we're already looking to the future.  If it sold exponentially well we'd of course take another look at it and support those who are supporting us, as we did with Prelude for years.
[/code]

We are currently wrapping up the February 2016 Update which is packed with new content.  We've done a quick teaser video which you can watch below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LU6n1Px_dog

We will be showing off this new update officially very soon.  Please feel free to ask any questions below or submit them to:
questions@trek-industries.com

Adjusted: Map and Character images now click-able in Lobby.
Adjusted: Enemies will now hang around Downed Players.
Adjusted: On Easy and Normal, 1 kill is enough to Self-Revive.
Fixed: Bug that would make T-Rex immortal.
Fixed: V-Sync not being applied in Video Settings.
Fixed: Double-Reload glitch.
Fixed: Issue where Fatalities were not counting as deaths.
Fixed: Issue with Server Browser not displaying reliable information.
Fixed: Bug where Typing nothing into the chat would lock Character movement.
Fixed: Chat window blocking mouse activity.
Fixed: Issue with Smoke Grenade radius being too large.
Fixed: Issue with HUD being hidden on Player spawn.
Removed: Skill Tree button popup when leveling for the first time.
[/quote]

Please feel free to restart your Steam clients to initiate the download.

notes.title: Guardians of Orion - Private Access Information
notes.content:
The very first 'Guardians of Orion' Private Access codes have started dispatching. We will continue to release them in waves of a few tthousand at a time.  The first thousand is tonight. The rest are continuing out tomorrow morning as we continue to montior the server capacity for the first major time.
- - -
Welcome to the Private Access version of 'Guardians of Orion', our brand new Steam game and the spiritual successor/prequel to 'ORION: Prelude'.

'Guardians of Orion' is a hyper-adrenaline, Twin-Stick Sci-Fi Shooter featuring Dinosaurs and Robots focused on Accessibility, Over-The-Top Gameplay, Power-Ups, 4-Player Local Multiplayer, Destruction, Gibs, Gore and more!

[b](TRAILER) Guardians of Orion - 10,000 Free Steam Copies[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WYVZ8AMZupw

[b] [ QUICK NOTES ] [/b]
1. This is a pre-alpha game build that will be entering Early Access (available to all of the public) on December 1, 2015.
2. Some audio is placeholder or non-existent.
3. All three Early Access maps are featured ('Arid', 'Outback' and 'Relic').
4. Many gameplay elements are not integrated, including some enemy attacks, gameplay mechanics, generator mechanics, other side objectives and more.
5. This copy of 'Guardians of Orion' will evolve into th Early Access and Official Version.
6. If you have any friends that own 'ORION: Prelude' ($1 on Steam) they can save 50% on Guardians from Dec 1 - Dec 15.
7. Steam-Friend joining is not currently integrated. Scheduled to arrive on Monday's patch (11/23/2015). For now use the browser and create lobbies with friends.

[b] [ DOWNLOAD STEAM ] [/b]
To install your game, please download Steam: 
http://store.steampowered.com/

[b] [ INSTALLATION ] [/b]
Step 1: Install Steam, Create Account. 
Step 2: Click the 'Games' tab at the top. 
Step 3: Select 'Activate a Product on Steam'. 
Step 4: Type in your Product Code. 
Step 5: Install 'Guardians of Orion'.

[b] [ QUICK TIPS ] [/b]
1. Please check the game settings for inputs. 
2. Please direct any questions to: 
3, feedback@trek-industries.com 
4, Melee attacks are powerful/great. Default key is V (Click Right Thumbstick).
5, Blinking is your new best friend. Default key is C (B Button).
6. Rolling is the new evade. Default key is Space Bar (A Button).
7. Every Guardian has their own unique ability. Default key is CTRL.(Left Shoulder).

[b] [ FEEDBACK SUBMISSION ] [/b]
We are looking for as much feedback as possible regarding any and all systems, including current gameplay functions, connectivity, servers, lobbies and more. We are expecting to release an update which will include a new map among many adjustments, addditions and fixes on Monday/Tuesday (10/19 or 10/20) to show what sort of pacing/rate we can integrate your submissions.

Please submit any videos/recordings/feedback to: 
[b]feedback@trek-industries.com[/b]

[b] [ SAVE 50% ] [/b]
Owners of ORION: Prelude will be able to save via a Loyalty Discount (50%) during the first two weeks of sale, from December 1 - December 15, 2015. You can opt into this saving by purchasing ORION: Prelude on Steam for $1:

Additionally, All Steam users are invited to save 10% during the first week of sale, from December 1 - December 7, 2015.

[b] [ MONTHLY UPDATES ] [/b]
We will be adding new features, tweaks and fixes on the 1st of every month via Content Updates.

[b] [ ONE YEAR OF EARLY ACCESS ] [/b]
Early Access for Guardians of Orion is scheduled to last one year (Dec 2015 - Dec 2016).

The Official Version of 'Guardians of Orion' will debut by the end of 2016 for $29.99 USD via Steam (Windows, Linux, Mac). Free (Windows version) for Early Access owners.

The Special Edition of 'Guardians of Orion' will debut in 2017 for $39.99 USD via Steam (Windows, Linux, Mac) and Playstation 4 + Xbox One. Free (Windows version) for Early Access / Official Version owners.

[b] [ YOU MAY MONETIZE ] [/b]
Feel free to upload and share any clips of gameplay with your fans and please submit any videos/recordings/feedback to: 
feedback@trek-industries.com

Thanks for playing!
